title: (Petty) Baron Schaefer
content: Brujah Baron of Mars Hill. He holds a unique treaty allowing Sabbat members to store heretical books and artifacts in his library for safekeeping as a disinterested third party.

title: 1888 Vanderbilt Purchase
content: The year George Vanderbilt began purchasing 12,500 acres for his estate. This event drew the Ventrue Elder Evander to the region to capitalize on the development.

title: 1900 Establishment of Praxis
content: The year Prince Evander declared the domain of Asheville safe from Lupines and officially established his Praxis.

title: 1910 Sabbat Incursion
content: The arrival of the Sword of Caine in Asheville, led by the young firebrand Tallula Donegan, seeking a stronghold for cross-Appalachian travel.

title: 1914 Betrayal of Evander
content: The pivotal moment when E.W. Grove betrayed his sire, Prince Evander, to the Sabbat. Evander was destroyed, and the domain fell to the Sword of Caine.

title: 1914 Lupine Truce
content: A treaty struck by Archbishop Tallula Donegan with the Lupines immediately after taking power. It established the Biltmore Estate as neutral/forbidden ground in exchange for peace.

title: 1927 Grove's Retirement
content: The year E.W. Grove faked his death/retired his mortal identity to rule entirely from the shadows as a vampire.

title: 1948 Highland Hospital Fire
content: A disaster used to cover up the scandal of Tallula's affair with the ghoul Zelda Fitzgerald. Zelda was embraced in front of the Diocese after the fire.

title: 1992 Black Hand Assassination
content: The first of several failed assassination attempts against Prince Tallula by the Black Hand following her defection to the Camarilla.

title: 1999 Red Star
content: Event where the Red Star appeared, prompting Tallula to crackdown on Gehenna cults.

title: 2000 Banu Haqim Seat
content: The year the Banu Haqim (via Magda Doluda) were granted a seat on the Primogen Council, replacing the Gangrel who had renounced it.

title: 2001 Arboretum Elysium
content: The establishment of the NC Arboretum as a second Elysium. It includes an amphitheater for ritual combat, a controversial move that echoed Sabbat traditions.

title: 2002 Path of Humanity
content: The year Prince Tallula successfully transitioned from the Path of Honorable Accord to the Path of Humanity, solidifying her Camarilla standing.

title: 2023 Edict of Succession
content: A decision ratified at the Grand Conclave listing Anarch domains in violation of Camarilla law.

title: 2023 Grand Conclave
content: Major political event. Gangrel rejoined Tower, Karsh vanished, new Justicars named.

title: 2023 Setite Negotiations
content: The formal beginning of talks to bring the Ministry (Setites) into the Camarilla, initiated at the Grand Conclave.

title: Abbot
content: The pack member responsible for the maintenance, security, and logistics of the communal haven. They ensure the pack has blood, weapons, and a safe place to sleep.

title: Abrams and Sherman
content: 9th Gen Tzimisce shovelheads trained by Howitzer Prime.

title: Abyssal Mysticism
content: Dark blood magic practiced by Lasombra (and some Sabbat). Involves summoning entities from the void. Rio de la Cruz is a practitioner.

title: Acknowledged
content: A status trait indicating a neonate has been accepted by the Prince as a full member of Camarilla society. Without it, a vampire has no rights.

title: Agitator
content: An Anarch title for a vampire who stirs up debate and questions the status quo to keep the movement honest.

title: Alastor
content: A specialized Archon or hunter dedicated solely to pursuing those on the 'Red List' (the Anathema). They are marked with a magical tattoo (The Trophy) and have global authority to command assistance.

title: Ambassador
content: A representative from another domain or sect (rarely). They negotiate treaties and maintain diplomatic channels.

title: Amici Noctis
content: 'The Friends of the Night'. The secret ruling council of Clan Lasombra. Mentioned in relation to Terissa and Maria Ramirez's plots.

title: Ana Maria Alverez (Traitor)
content: Lasombra Elder. Betrayed Archon Tallula in Argentina, declared herself Baron of Rosario, and claimed credit for killing the Archon.

title: Anarch Free State
content: A territory where the Camarilla hierarchy is rejected, and Anarchs rule by committee or survival of the fittest. The most famous was Los Angeles before it fell.

title: Anarch Movement
content: A sect of vampires who reject the rigid hierarchy of the Camarilla but still mostly uphold the Masquerade. They value freedom and equality (in theory) and often hold territory in 'Free States'. Baron Schaefer runs the local Anarch pocket in Mars Hill.

title: Anarch Revolt (Argentina)
content: Reference to the defection of Ana Maria Alverez and the fall of Rosario to the Anarchs in late 2024.

title: Anathema
content: Another name for the Red List.

title: Ancilla
content: A vampire of intermediate age and status (typically 50-300 years). They serve as the ambitious middle management of the sect, aiming for Elder status.

title: Angellis Ater
content: The 'Black Angels'. A bloodline of Lasombra who turned to infernalism and joined the Baali. They combine Obtenebration with Daimoinon.

title: Anne Bonny
content: Historical pirate cited as a 'vibe' for Tallula Donegan.

title: Anne-Marie Honey
content: 11th Gen Brujah of Cast and Crew. Diablerized Dan Drifter. Toady.

title: Antediluvian
content: The progenitors of the clans, from the time before the Great Flood. They are the sleeping gods of the Kindred, whose waking brings Gehenna.

title: Antitribu
content: 'Anti-tribe'. Vampires who have defected from their parent clan's main sect. (e.g., Ventrue antitribu in the Sabbat). They often display twisted versions of their clan traits.

title: Appalachian Covenant Militia (ACM)
content: A localized hunter organization rooted in Baptist doctrine and mountain survivalism. They view vampires as demons and utilize guerrilla tactics and faith-based weaponry. They are a persistent low-level threat to Kindred operating in the rural outskirts.

title: Apprentice
content: A Tremere rank for a neonate or ancilla who has not yet achieved the rank of Regent. There are seven circles of apprenticeship.

title: Arcady Sabo
content: Lasombra Neonate and Primogen. A young but ambitious Shadow, he represents his clan's interests and strives to prove that the Lasombra are a pillar of the Ivory Tower, not its enemy. He is involved in the financial and political spheres.

title: Archbishop
content: The ruler of a Sabbat city or domain. Unlike a Prince, their rule is often shared with a council of Bishops, though they are the ultimate authority in military and spiritual matters for that city.

title: Archbishop Mallori Mayhem
content: Malkavian Antitribu. Former Archon to Cardinal Polonia. Claimed the Bloodbath on August 2nd, 2025, establishing a new Sabbat Archdiocese in the region.

title: Architect (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may attend and witness Judicial Conclaves (but may not speak unless given permission). You may also approach and petition any Justicar or hosting Prince at a Conclave.

title: Architect (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may place an agenda item as a topic for the Speaker at a Conclave.

title: Archon
content: An agent and deputy of a Justicar. They travel the world enforcing the Justicar's will, investigating corruption, and hunting the Red List. They carry the full authority of their patron.

title: Archon Ferrum Civis
content: Tremere Archon sent to inspect Asheville in Dec 2024. Destroyed upon arrival.

title: Archon Tallula Donegan (Deceased?)
content: Toreador Elder. Named Archon in 2025 and sent to Argentina. Reportedly hurled from the Alvear Tower in Buenos Aires by the traitor Ana Maria Alverez on Nov 1, 2025.

title: Ascendant (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You are immune to the powers of, and may contradict orders given by, any individual who does not have the Ascendant status.

title: Ascendant (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may give the Negative Status 'Disgraced' or initiate a global blood hunt. Three expenditures (from different sources) add a target to the Red List or issue a doctrinal edict.

title: Auctoritas Ritae
content: The High Rituals of the Sabbat. Thirteen rituals (like the Vaulderie, Creation Rites, Monomacy) practiced by the entire sect to ensure loyalty and unity.

title: Autark
content: A vampire outside the sect system. Johannan Wilder was one before 2011.

title: Autarkis
content: A vampire who refuses to join the Camarilla or any other sect, living on the fringes of society. They claim no rights and offer no allegiance.

title: Authority (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may award the Fleeting Statuses 'Courageous', 'Defender', 'Honorable', or 'Loyal' without expending the trait. A target can only hold one such awarded status from the same source at a time.

title: Authority (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may punish or pardon. Expend to give the Negative Status 'Warned' or 'Forsaken', or to remove them.

title: Baali
content: An infernal bloodline of vampires who worship demons. They are hated and hunted by both Camarilla and Sabbat.

title: Background: Generation (Ancilla)
content: Mechanical background. 2 dots = 10th Gen. 3 dots = 9th Gen. 11-12 Blood Pool. Support for Techniques.

title: Background: Generation (Elder)
content: Mechanical background. 4 dots = 8th Gen. 5 dots = 7th Gen. 13-15+ Blood Pool. Access to Elder Powers.

title: Background: Generation (Neonate)
content: Mechanical background. 1 dot = 11th Gen. Can take flaws to lower to 12th/13th. 10 Blood Pool, 1 Blood/turn. Cheaper XP costs for skills/backgrounds.

title: Baelfire
content: 11th Gen Tzimisce of Old Guard. Scientist interested in the boundaries of unlife.

title: Baron Schaefer
content: The Brujah Baron of Mars Hill and a key Anarch figure. She controls the Mars Hill University library, a repository of lore often considered heretical or forbidden by the Camarilla. She remained neutral during the 1991 domain flip and maintains a tense but functional peace with the Tower.
keywords: anarch,anarch baron,baron,baron schaefer,brujah,librarian,library,lore keeper,mars hill,neutral party,schaefer

title: Basilica of St. Lawrence
content: The primary Elysium of Greater Asheville. It features the largest freestanding dome on the East Coast and houses deep catacombs used for secure meetings. The sanctity of this holy ground is fiercely protected by the Keeper and the Sheriff.

title: Basillia (Justicar)
content: The Gangrel Justicar appointed/confirmed in 2023 after the clan's return to the Tower.

title: Beau Brummell
content: Banu Haqim Elder and Whip. A sophisticated and dangerous Assamite who enforces the internal discipline of his clan. He is a master of the silent knife and the diplomatic word.

title: Bele Chere Festival
content: A massive street festival in Asheville held in August. A backdrop for intense social maneuvering and potential Masquerade breaches due to the crowds.

title: Biafra
content: Nosferatu Neonate and Deputy Scourge. A terrifying investigator and enforcer who hunts the unacknowledged and the enemies of the Prince. He uses his skills in obfuscation and combat to patrol the shadows.

title: Big Bird
content: 9th Gen Nosferatu Ductus of Hushed Puppies. Monster.

title: Big Ben (Destroyed)
content: Elder of unknown clan. Former Seneschal. Bloodhunted by Prince Daveed and destroyed by Elara (Brujah) on July 5th, 2025.

title: Bill Colson
content: Ventrue Ancilla and Deputy Scourge. A more formal enforcer of the Prince's will, ensuring that those who violate the hospitality of the domain are removed or punished. He works in tandem with the Sheriff's office.

title: Biltmore No-Go Zone
content: The strict edict that no Kindred may enter the Biltmore Estate. It acts as a memorial to the tyrant Prince Evander and is enforced by a fragile treaty with the Lupines.

title: Bishop
content: A Sabbat leader who advises the Archbishop or oversees a specific aspect of the city (e.g., Bishop of War, Bishop of the Faith). They advise the Archbishop and command respect from local packs.

title: Black Hand
content: The 'Lost Tribe'. A secret military order within the Sabbat (and beyond) dedicated to the service of the Antediluvians (or Caine, depending on the faction).

title: Black Mountain
content: Outlying town mentioned as a Sabbat stronghold in 1991 and present day.

title: Black Mountain Neuro-Medical Center
content: A ominous medical facility and Sabbat stronghold. Tallula was seen visiting here to meet with Sabbat leaders.

title: Blood Bond (Vinculum)
content: A mystical emotional slavery created by drinking the blood of another vampire three times. The thrall becomes obsessively loyal to the regnant. The Sabbat uses a communal version called the Vaulderie to bond packs to each other rather than a master.

title: Blood Brothers
content: A Sabbat bloodline created by the Tzimisce to be perfect shock troops. They share a hive mind and health levels within their circle (pack). 'Roach' is a Blood Brother pack.

title: Blood Doll
content: A mortal who willingly lets vampires feed on them, often addicted to the sensation of the Kiss (the pleasure of the bite).

title: Blood Hunt
content: The Lextalionis. A decree by the Prince declaring a Kindred unwanted and stripping them of all status and protection. Any Kindred may hunt and slay them.
keywords: blood hunt,death sentence,hunt,law of retaliation,lex talionis

title: Blood Leech
content: A vampire who feeds on other vampires. Dangerous and frowned upon (or illegal).

title: Blood Resonance
content: The emotional or physical quality of blood (dyscrasia) that provides bonuses to disciplines. e.g., Melancholy blood boosts Obfuscate.

title: Bloodline: Ananke
content: A Malkavian bloodline obsessed with fate and trophies. If they cannot take a trophy from a conflict, they cannot regain Willpower.

title: Bloodline: Brahman
content: A Ravnos bloodline representing the priestly caste. Philosophers and gurus who seek enlightenment. In-clan disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Chimerstry.

title: Bloodline: Coyote
content: Also known as City Gangrel. A bloodline comfortable in urban environments. They possess Celerity and Obfuscate but lack Fortitude.

title: Bloodline: Crusaders
content: A Ventrue bloodline more akin to soldiers than princes. They are excellent trackers and prone to cruelty. Known for sadism.

title: Bloodline: Ishtarri
content: A Toreador bloodline from Africa. They are dancers, acrobats, and spies. They suffer a penalty to resisting emotion-controlling powers.

title: Bloodline: Knights of the Moon
content: Malkavians who do not manifest Dementation, but instead possess Dominate. Their insanity manifests as cold sociopathy or dark intellectualization.

title: Bloodline: Telyav
content: A Tremere bloodline of Lithuanian warlocks who practice animistic magic. Presumed extinct but hiding among the Sabbat. They possess Presence instead of Dominate.

title: Bloodline: True Brujah (Sages)
content: A bloodline that claims to be the true heirs of Brujah, reviling the emotional 'rabble'. They practice Temporis (time manipulation) and are emotionally cold.

title: Bloodline: Volgirre
content: A Toreador bloodline of antitribu who returned to the Camarilla in 2011. Led by Philippe Volgirre. They can learn Vicissitude without a teacher.

title: Boon
content: The currency of favors in Kindred society. Categorized as Trivial, Minor, Major, and Life Boons. Debts must be repaid.

title: Boons: Life
content: The ultimate favor. Saving a vampire's unlife. The debtor effectively belongs to the creditor.

title: Boons: Major
content: A large favor (e.g., saving a reputation, killing a rival). Shifts the balance of power.

title: Boons: Minor
content: A significant favor (e.g., use of influence, teaching a discipline). Requires effort to repay.

title: Boons: Trivial
content: A small favor (e.g., a ride, an introduction). One-time service.

title: Briar O'Connor
content: 9th Gen Gangrel of Old Guard. Former Kinfolk, protects her sister Nettle (Black Spiral Dancer).

title: Brood
content: A group of vampires sired by the same vampire. They are 'siblings' in blood.

title: Bugs
content: Nosferatu Ancilla and Master Harpy. The successor to Sister Tiffany, Bugs now controls the flow of status and scandal in Greater Asheville. Their word can make or break a Kindred's reputation in the court.

title: Cadet
content: A recruit in training for the Black Hand. They must survive rigorous trials to become a full member.

title: Cainite
content: The preferred term Sabbat vampires use for themselves, emphasizing their descent from Caine and rejection of their human past (unlike 'Kindred').

title: Cainite Heresy
content: A Gnostic belief from the Dark Ages claiming vampires were angels sent by God to rule over mortals. It infiltrated the Church before being crushed by the Inquisition.

title: Caitiff
content: The Clanless. Vampires who do not share the specific traits or social acceptance of a parent clan. They are often treated as second-class citizens or mistakes. They can learn any discipline but lack the social support structure of a clan.

title: Cardinal
content: A high-ranking Sabbat leader who oversees a vast geographic region (e.g., the East Coast). They coordinate war efforts, sieges, and the movements of Archbishops. They hold a seat on the Consistory.

title: Carthage
content: The ancient city of the Brujah, where vampires lived openly with mortals. It was destroyed by the Ventrue and Roman armies, who salted the earth to bind the infernalists believed to hide there.

title: Cassandra Grey
content: Malkavian Ancilla and Primogen. She is a seer and investigator, deeply involved in unraveling the mysteries of the Sabbat's movements and the internal threats to the domain. She recently sought tutelage in Necromancy.

title: Cast and Crew of Mallori Mayhem
content: A media-savvy Sabbat pack led by the chaotic Malkavian antitribu Mallori Mayhem. They utilize social media and flash-mob tactics to disrupt the Masquerade and terrorize the Kine. They view the Gehenna War as a form of performance art and are based out of the digital shadows.

title: Celerity Round
content: Additional rounds in a combat turn that occur after the Everyman Round. Only characters with the Celerity discipline may act during these rounds.

title: Chancelor
content: A title sometimes used for the Keeper of records or a high-ranking advisor who manages the city's mortal influence and bureaucracy.

title: Changeling
content: A fae soul reborn in a human body. They are creatures of dreams and glamour. Kindred find them confusing and their blood (fae blood) has hallucinogenic properties.

title: Chicken Alley
content: A local Asheville landmark mentioned as existing in the darker Greater Asheville setting, implying the inclusion of local urban legends in the game's atmosphere.

title: Childe
content: The progeny of a vampire. Until released, they are the responsibility of their sire.

title: Chorazin
content: The accursed city of the Baali. Believed to be where the infernalist clan retreats to worship their dark masters and await Gehenna.

title: Chronicle Theme: Isolation
content: A central theme of the chronicle, reflecting the geography of the mountains and the political isolation of a Camarilla domain surrounded by Sabbat and Anarch territories.

title: Chronicle Theme: Religious Trauma
content: A specific theme explored in the game due to the setting's Sabbat history, acknowledging that much of the Sabbat's iconography and control mechanisms are twisted from Catholic trappings.

title: Clan Banu Haqim (Assamite)
content: The Clan of the Hunt. Judges, warriors, and viziers from the Middle East who recently joined the Camarilla. They utilize Quietus (silence/poison), Celerity, and Obfuscate. Their curse involves a darkening of the skin with age or a hunger for vampire blood (depending on caste).

title: Clan Brujah
content: The Clan of the Learned (Rabble). Once philosopher-kings, now rebels and punks. They are prone to frenzy and value freedom and change. Their powers are Celerity, Potence, and Presence. They suffer from a short temper, increasing the difficulty to resist frenzy.

title: Clan Gangrel
content: The Clan of the Beast. They are closer to their feral nature than any other clan, often living in the wild. Their powers are Animalism, Fortitude, and Protean (shapeshifting). When they frenzy, they gain temporary animal features. They are the outriders and scouts of the Camarilla.

title: Clan Lasombra
content: The Clan of Night (Magisters). Formerly leaders of the Sabbat, many have defected to the Camarilla. They are social Darwinists who value strength and excellence. Their signature power is Obtenebration (control of shadows), along with Dominate and Potence. They cast no reflection in mirrors.

title: Clan Malkavian
content: The Clan of the Moon. Cursed with insanity, they see truths others miss. They are oracles and madmen. Their powers include Auspex, Obfuscate, and Dementation (spreading madness). Every Malkavian suffers from at least one permanent, incurable mental derangement.

title: Clan Nosferatu
content: The Clan of the Hidden. Twisted by the curse of Caine into hideous monsters, they hide in the sewers and shadows. They are the spymasters of the Kindred. Their powers are Animalism, Obfuscate (invisibility), and Potence (super strength). Their flaw is their horrific appearance, which breaches the Masquerade instantly.
keywords: animalism,clan of the hidden,horrific appearance,obfuscate,potence,sewer rats,spies

title: Clan Toreador
content: The Clan of the Rose. They are artists, critics, and hedonists who value beauty and passion above all. Their powers are Auspex (heightened senses), Celerity (supernatural speed), and Presence (attraction/fear). They are often distracted by beauty, freezing in awe of artistic perfection.

title: Clan Tremere
content: The Clan of Warlocks. Former mages who stole immortality through blood sorcery. They are a pyramid scheme of occult power. Their unique discipline is Thaumaturgy (Blood Sorcery), alongside Auspex and Dominate. They are bound by a rigid hierarchy and often distrusted by other clans.

title: Clan Ventrue
content: The Clan of Kings. They value hierarchy, lineage, and the power to command. Their signature powers are Dominate (mental control), Fortitude (supernatural resilience), and Presence (emotional manipulation). They suffer from a rarefied palate, able to feed only from a specific type of vessel.

title: Clarence Henco
content: A Tremere wraith haunting the lost Chantry. Died protecting it in 1914.

title: Cleaner
content: A Sabbat vampire responsible for cleaning up the Masquerade breaches (or 'Silence of the Blood' breaches) left after a raid.

title: Cleaver
content: A vampire who tries to live a normal family life with mortals. Extremely risky.

title: Cleo
content: 9th Gen Setite Pack Priest of Cast and Crew. Enigma.

title: Cobbler
content: A Sabbat vampire (often Nosferatu) who creates fake identities and papers for the pack to move through mortal society.

title: Cock Robin (Justicar)
content: The Nosferatu Justicar. Confirmed in the 2023 post-Conclave shuffle.

title: Code of Milan
content: The governing document of the Sabbat, emphasizing the duality of freedom and loyalty. It was adopted to stabilize the sect during civil wars in the New World.

title: Commander (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may issue orders to any sect member without Authority, and expect obedience. Disobedience strips the target of all Fleeting Status temporarily. You may also deputize up to 3 individuals with 'Enforcer' for a night.

title: Commander (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may award up to three characters either the Fleeting Status 'Courageous' or 'Loyal'.

title: Condition: Bound
content: Being blood bound to another. The character must defer to the regnant.

title: Condition: Frenzying
content: Under the control of the Beast. Attack or flee (Rötschreck).

title: Condition: Impaired
content: Suffering from wound penalties. Dice pools are reduced.

title: Condition: Staked
content: Paralyzed by a wooden stake through the heart. Conscious but unable to move.

title: Condition: Torpid
content: Being in Torpor. The character is unconscious and vulnerable.

title: Confirmed (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may approach any officer of the sect without a formal introduction, avoiding social penalties.

title: Confirmed (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may order a non-supernatural mortal (ghoul, revenant) beholden to the sect to obey you (unless contradicting their master). You have the authority to kill such a mortal if they refuse. Cannot be used in combat.

title: Consensualist
content: A vampire who only feeds from willing victims (without coercion/discipline). rare and difficult.

title: Consistory
content: The council of Cardinals and Prisci that advises the Regent of the Sabbat.

title: Consul
content: A representative of the Camarilla sent to a non-Camarilla city (like an Anarch Free State) to act as a liaison and observer.

title: Convention of Thorns (1493)
content: The treaty signed at the Abbey of the Sacred Crown that ended the first Anarch Revolt. It officially formed the Camarilla and forced the Anarchs to join or flee (becoming the Sabbat).

title: Coterie
content: A small group of vampires who band together for mutual protection and political gain. The basic social unit of the Camarilla.

title: Courageous (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You can use a combat maneuver once per game without spending Willpower. Only usable when following the directives of someone with Authority or Commander status.

title: Courageous (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: If not violating sect laws, expend to allow one character (self or other) to use a combat maneuver without spending Willpower.

title: Courteous (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You cannot be targeted by the Subterfuge skill to redirect blame for the use of a supernatural power.

title: Courteous (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Overcome any political gaffe or etiquette error made in the last five minutes. The error is acknowledged but must be forgiven/ignored by those present.

title: Courtesies of Spirituality
content: Rules regarding faith and art. Prohibits the Vaulderie. Art competitions held quarterly.

title: Courtesies of War
content: Rules regarding combat and boundaries. Biltmore is off-limits. Scourge handles poachers.

title: Creation Rites
content: The Sabbat method of Embrace. Often involves 'shovelheading'—draining a victim, bashing them with a shovel, and burying them to claw their way out.

title: Cross-Appalachian Travel
content: The strategic goal of the Sabbat in 1910—to control the mountain passes for movement.

title: Crossroads Music Studio
content: A recording studio in Arden destroyed by fire in March 2025. Site of the Masquerade breach by Zephyr.

title: Daggerface
content: Abbot of Murder Piñata. An 11th Gen Gangrel fanatic who uses Vicissitude to enhance his combat prowess.

title: Dahlonega Mint
content: The historical mint in Georgia seized by Confederates. Source of the 'bbat coins. The gold extracted has a psychic signature of murder.

title: Daire Manning
content: Banu Haqim Sorcerer Abbot of 150 Guns.

title: Damien Natosa's Fashion Symbel
content: A contest held by the Elder Tzimisce/Ventrue Damien Natosa to update his wardrobe after waking from torpor.

title: Dan Drifter
content: Deceased Gangrel of Maximum Fatality. Diablerized by Anne-Marie Honey.

title: Dark Selina
content: A rare vinyl record by The Hex. Contains subliminal messaging or mystical properties. Highly sought after.

title: Daughters of Cacophony
content: A bloodline of singers whose voices can shatter minds or objects. They are a split from the Toreador or Malkavians.

title: Daveed Fourié
content: Banu Haqim Ancilla and the current Prince of Greater Asheville (following Tallula's disappearance). He faces the monumental task of holding the domain together against Sabbat incursions, Anarch unrest, and the scrutiny of the Justicariate.

title: David (Ductus)
content: 9th Gen Brujah Ductus of The Satyr Boys. Loyalist.

title: Defender (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may carry weapons to any gathering, including restricted ones. Authorities must allow you to go armed.

title: Defender (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Reduce the number of Beast traits gained by one (1) when performing an action that triggers a sin. Limit one per sin.

title: Denice Lane
content: 10th Gen Brujah of Cast and Crew. Fighter.

title: Deputy
content: An assistant to an official (Sheriff, Scourge, Keeper). They derive their authority from their superior and serve at their pleasure.

title: Derangement: Compulsion
content: A specific derangement mechanics for Ravnos. They are compelled to indulge in a specific vice (lying, theft) when the opportunity arises.

title: Diablerie (The Amaranth)
content: The act of draining a vampire to the point of final death and consuming their soul. It allows the diablerist to lower their generation and gain power, but stains their aura with black veins. It is the ultimate crime in the Camarilla.

title: Diocese of WNC
content: The organizational term for the Sabbat presence in Western North Carolina, consisting of various packs like 'Yule Tied' and 'Mallori Mayhem'.

title: Dire (Bishop)
content: Gargoyle. The Sabbat Bishop of War. A terrifying combatant for the new Archdiocese.

title: Discipline: Animalism
content: The power to communicate with and command the beast within animals and Kindred. Used by Gangrel and Nosferatu to summon swarms, ride the minds of beasts, and quell the frenzy of other vampires.
keywords: animal control,animalism,beast mastery,familiars,feral whispers,quell the beast

title: Discipline: Auspex
content: The power of heightened senses and extrasensory perception. Used by Toreador, Malkavians, and Tremere to see invisible things, read auras, and project their consciousness astrally.

title: Discipline: Celerity
content: The power of supernatural speed. Used by Brujah, Toreador, and Banu Haqim to move faster than the eye can follow, gaining extra actions in combat and dodging attacks with ease.

title: Discipline: Dementation
content: The power to externalize madness. Originally unique to the Malkavians, it allows the user to inflict hysteria, hallucinations, and confusion upon victims, sharing the clan's curse with the world.

title: Discipline: Dominate
content: The power of mental compulsion and command. Used primarily by Ventrue, Tremere, and Lasombra to force obedience, erase memories, or rewrite personalities. It requires eye contact and a shared language.

title: Discipline: Fortitude
content: The power of supernatural resilience. Used by Ventrue, Gangrel, and Ravnos to soak damage that would pulverize a mortal, including fire and sunlight (to a degree). It is the shield of the immortal.

title: Discipline: Necromancy
content: The magic of death and souls, practiced by the Giovanni and some other bloodlines. It allows communication with wraiths, raising zombies, and manipulating the entropy of life.

title: Discipline: Obfuscate
content: The power of supernatural concealment. Used by Nosferatu, Malkavians, and Banu Haqim to cloud the minds of observers, becoming effectively invisible. It can also be used to disguise one's appearance.

title: Discipline: Obtenebration
content: The power to manipulate darkness and shadows, tapping into the Abyss. The signature power of the Lasombra. Users can create tentacles of shadow, shroud areas in pitch blackness, or become a shadow themselves.
keywords: abyss,arms of the abyss,darkness,obtenebration,shadow form,shadow manipulation

title: Discipline: Potence
content: The power of supernatural strength. Used by Brujah, Nosferatu, and Lasombra to crush stone, lift cars, and deal devastating damage in melee combat. It is the raw physical might of the Blood.

title: Discipline: Presence
content: The power of emotional manipulation. Used by Toreador, Ventrue, and Brujah to attract, terrify, or command the attention of others without direct mind control. It works on crowds and sways emotions.

title: Discipline: Protean
content: The power of shapeshifting. The signature discipline of the Gangrel, allowing them to grow claws, see in the dark, turn into a mist, or transform into a wolf or bat.

title: Discipline: Quietus
content: The silent art of death practiced by the Banu Haqim. It involves silencing sounds, creating virulent blood poisons, and eroding the stamina of victims. It is the tool of the assassin.

title: Discipline: Thaumaturgy (Blood Sorcery)
content: The jealously guarded magic of Clan Tremere. It is versatile and dangerous, capable of boiling blood, moving objects with the mind, or summoning fire. It is divided into Paths (like Path of Blood) and Rituals.
keywords: blood magic,blood sorcery,path of blood,rituals,sorcery,thaumaturgy,tremere secret

title: Discipline: Vicissitude
content: The alien power of flesh and bone crafting, practiced by the Tzimisce. It allows the user to mold living tissue like clay, creating beautiful or horrific alterations to themselves and others.

title: Disgraced (Censure)
content: Censure: Prohibited from carrying weapons or using powers near officers without permission. Cannot feed in sect territory (scraps only). Cannot spend or gain status. Boons owed to you need not be repaid.

title: Disgraced (Removal)
content: Removal: Lasts as long as you hold 'Warned'. If acquired without 'Warned', lasts for two games or one month (whichever is longer). Can be removed by apologizing and paying a Major Boon to the officer if caught violating.

title: Domain
content: The physical territory claimed by a Prince or granted to a vassal. The holder of a domain has the right to feed within it and restrict access to others.

title: Domain of Charlotte
content: 'The Golden Tower'. A neighboring Camarilla domain.

title: Domain of Johnson City
content: Anarch domain ruled by Baron Santos. Ally of Schaefer.

title: Domain of Knoxville
content: 'The Marble Tyrant'. A neighboring domain ruled by Prince Iago.

title: Dominion
content: A mid-level commander in the Black Hand, leading a 'Kamut' (a pack of Black Hand operatives).

title: Dr. Lenore Scott
content: The Seneschal of the Triangle. A Ventrue scholar who handles the day-to-day logistics of Malphas's domain. She is known for her medical background and detailed correspondence.

title: Ductus
content: The tactical leader of a Sabbat pack. Chosen by the pack (not appointed from above), they make the combat decisions and decide the pack's immediate goals.

title: Ductus Dire
content: Leader of Witch Hunt. 7th Gen Gargoyle. Fanatic loyalist to the Sabbat cause.

title: Dwayne
content: 9th Gen Gangrel of The Satyr Boys.

title: E.W. Grove (Keeper Emeritus)
content: Ventrue Ancilla and owner of the Grove Park Inn. Granted his wish to make the Inn an Elysium in June 2025 by Prince Daveed, shortly before being replaced as Keeper by Michael Valentine.

title: Ed (Redcap)
content: A Redcap and 'Vizier' to King Leopold. Terrifying enforcer who is rumored to be Leopold's lover. Originally from Baton Rouge.

title: Elara
content: Brujah Neonate. Carries a 'Jar of teeth from Big Ben's haven' and a copy of his journal. Has a weird voice in her head that might be Big Ben.

title: Elder
content: A vampire of significant age (usually 300+ years) and generation. They hold the true power in the Camarilla and are masters of the Jyhad.

title: Elysium
content: Designated safe havens within the city where violence is prohibited and the arts are celebrated. Often located in high-end venues like the Art Gallery or historical sites.

title: Elysium: The Basilica
content: The Basilica of St. Lawrence in Asheville. The primary seat of courtly interaction.

title: Elysium: The Grove
content: A localized term for the Grove Park Inn Elysium under Keeper E.W. Grove.

title: Emerald Beauregard
content: Banu Haqim Neonate. Goes by 'Basil'. Investigated the Banu Haqim feeding territory and had a derangement break at a Gather.

title: Enforcer (Pack)
content: A pack role for the strongest combatant, responsible for physical threats to the pack.

title: Enforcer (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: You may carry weapons to any gathering. You may deputize up to two others with 'Defender' for a single night.

title: Enforcer (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Give the Negative Status 'Warned' to an individual you legitimately believe has broken sect or domain law.

title: Enebishin
content: Gangrel Neonate. An archer who uses a bow with Silver and Incendiary arrows. Drives a Superior Motorcycle.

title: Erin Yesse
content: Brujah Neonate and Enforcer. A street-level fighter and protector of the domain. Erin is often on the front lines against Sabbat incursions and breaches of the peace.

title: Esmerelda Camazot Yuritzi
content: Gangrel Elder and Whip. An ancient and primal force within the clan. She guides the Gangrel in their connection to the Beast and the land, ensuring they remain useful guardians of the domain.

title: Established (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Anyone who openly insults, threatens, or attacks you automatically receives the Negative Status 'Warned'. (Authority/Commander/Triumphant are immune).

title: Established (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: You may give the Fleeting Status 'Favored'.

title: Euagetaematikon
content: The 'Book of Blood'. The sacred text of the Cainite Heresy.

title: Evander
content: Former Ventrue Prince of Asheville. Betrayed by E.W. Grove and destroyed by Tallula in 1914.

title: Everyman Round
content: The first round of a combat turn where every participant acts. Followed by Celerity rounds where only those with Celerity act.

title: FBI Incursion (Sept 2025)
content: The arrival of federal agents in Asheville, prompting Prince Daveed to order Erecura to alter her appearance to avoid the Second Inquisition.

title: Face (Pack)
content: A pack role for the vampire who handles social interactions with outsiders or other packs.

title: Faith Blake
content: 9th Gen Lasombra Abbot of Cast and Crew. Free Spirit.

title: False Sabbat
content: A vampire who claims membership but has not yet proven themselves (or is suspected of treason). They have no rights and are often used as cannon fodder.

title: Favored (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Anyone who openly attacks you automatically receives 'Warned' (unless immune). Shows you have a patron.

title: Favored (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Negate a negative status before it is applied. The attacker cannot attempt to apply negative status to you again for the night.

title: Feeding Grid
content: The abstract system used by the Primogen Council to allocate hunting grounds. The city is split into a numbered grid rather than complex street borders to streamline political distribution of territory.

title: Feeding Territories
content: Grid-based system for hunting. Clans must patrol their assigned blocks. All blocks provide equal sustenance.

title: Feeding Territory: The Rack
content: Two specific blocks in downtown Asheville reserved for visiting Kindred and those without their own domain. It is a high-traffic nightlife area. Resident Kindred with assigned territories are forbidden from hunting here to ensure hospitality for guests.

title: Feodor Ilyasov
content: Ventrue Elder. Uses the name 'Theodor'. Possesses 'Social Nobility' and a 'Prestigious Sire' (Anya Doyamin). Wears a flashy artisan necklace.

title: Fetter
content: An object or person that ties a wraith to the living world. Helen's fetter is her sister (or the bridge itself, effectively).

title: Fire Dance
content: A Sabbat rite where vampires prove their bravery by jumping through fire. Builds courage against Rötschreck.

title: Firestorm Cafe
content: A neutral ground or popular meeting spot within the city, often frequented by Kindred of various standings.

title: Firewalker
content: A vampire who has passed the Fire Dance ritual and is respected for their bravery.

title: Fledgling
content: A brand new vampire still under the protection and accounting of their sire. They are not yet full members of Camarilla society and have no rights of their own.

title: Forsaken (Censure)
content: Censure: You are no longer Accepted. You hold no status. You may be destroyed without repercussion. Society's laws do not protect you.

title: Forsaken (Removal)
content: Removal: Can only be removed by an expenditure of Authority status (pardon). Usually permanent until death.

title: Founded Pack
content: A Sabbat pack that settles permanently in a city, establishing a communal haven and taking territory.

title: Gallant (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: None.

title: Gallant (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Overcome any political/etiquette error made in the last 5 minutes. The error is acknowledged but must be forgiven.

title: Games of Instinct
content: Sabbat 'sports' used to hone predatory skills. Examples include 'Cowboys and Indians' (hunting mortals) or 'Demolition Derby'.

title: Gargoyles
content: A slave race created by the Tremere from the body parts of Gangrel, Nosferatu, and Tzimisce to fight in the Gargoyle Revolt. Now a free bloodline.

title: Gehenna
content: The prophesied end times when the Antediluvians will rise from torpor to devour their children. The Sabbat fights a war to prevent this, while the Camarilla traditionally denied its existence (until recently).

title: Gehenna Cults
content: Cults predicting the end of the world, cracked down upon by Tallula in 1999.

title: George Vanderbilt
content: Mortal tycoon whose estate purchase in 1888 catalyzed the Kindred population of Asheville.

title: Ghoul
content: A mortal servant fed vampire blood. They serve as daylight agents, bodyguards, and retainers. They are considered property of their domitor.

title: Ghoul Family: Bratovich
content: A Revenant family serving the Tzimisce. Kennemasters and monsters. Known for violence and lack of hygiene.

title: Ghoul Family: Grimaldi
content: A Revenant family serving the Sabbat (and sometimes Camarilla). Socialites and politicians.

title: Ghoul Family: Obertus
content: A Revenant family serving the Tzimisce. Scholars and occultists.

title: Ghoul Family: Zantosa
content: A Revenant family serving the Tzimisce/Toreador. Hedonists and drug dealers.

title: Ghouling
content: The act of feeding vitae to a mortal to create a Ghoul servant.

title: Gideon's Chosen Few
content: A sophisticated and well-funded hunter network operating a compound near Swannanoa. They view themselves as holy knights on a crusade. Unlike the ACM, they possess advanced technology and tactical training, making them a severe threat to the Masquerade.

title: Giovanni
content: A clan of necromancers and incestuous families. They are an independent clan (until recently) focused on wealth and family. They diablerized their founder Cappadocius.

title: Golconda
content: A mythical state of enlightenment and balance between the Man and the Beast. Kindred who achieve it are said to master their hunger and frenzy, finding peace in their damnation. It is the ultimate spiritual goal for many, though few attain it.

title: Grand Conclave
content: The highest gathering of the Camarilla, occurring rarely (last in 2023), where Justicars are chosen.

title: Grand Inquisitor
content: The head of the Sabbat Inquisition. A terrifying figure who directs the hunt for infernalists and heretics across the entire sect.

title: Grant Smalls
content: Tremere Neonate Steward. Possesses specific occult books like 'Libations of the Vampire' and 'Vitae and Voles'. Has a tattoo of a pentagram over his heart.

title: Grant Smalls (Steward)
content: Tremere Neonate appointed as the first Steward of Elysium by Michael Valentine.

title: Graverobber
content: A vampire who feeds from corpses (Nagaraja/Samedi) or chills in cemeteries.

title: Greater Asheville
content: The fictional setting of the chronicle, encompassing Asheville, NC, and surrounding areas like Black Mountain. Formerly a Sabbat stronghold, it 'flipped' to the Camarilla in the early 90s.

title: Grove Arcade
content: A massive skyscraper in the World of Darkness version of Asheville, completed by E.W. Grove in 1929. A common meeting place.

title: Grove Arcade (Skyscraper)
content: In the Greater Asheville setting, E.W. Grove's masterpiece was completed in 1929 (unlike the real world), standing as a massive 14-story skyscraper. It is the tallest building in the city and a monolith of Kindred influence.

title: Grove House (Nightlife)
content: A location originally a YWCA, now a hub for Kindred nightlife. Despite the name, it is not owned by E.W. Grove, but was controlled by Prince Tallula Donegan as a public meeting space.

title: Grove Park Inn
content: The personal domain of Keeper E.W. Grove. A sprawling, ornate hotel.

title: Guardian (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Award 'Warned' to anyone behaving inappropriately in your jurisdiction or disrespecting your proclamations.

title: Guardian (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Give the Negative Status 'Disgraced'. Keepers declare 'Profane', Harpies declare 'Boonbreaker'.

title: Guruhi
content: A Laibon lineage of kings and land-rulers in Africa. They blend ancient tradition with modern corporate engineering.

title: Hailey Coleman
content: Tremere Neonate. Spent time being exasperated at her clanmates. Owns a Ouija Board customized for seances.

title: Harbinger
content: A messenger sent ahead of a nomadic pack or war party to announce their arrival (or issue threats).

title: Harbingers of Skulls
content: The remnants of the Cappadocian clan who returned from the Shadowlands (or Kaymakli) to join the Sabbat. They wear masks to hide their skull-like faces.

title: Harold Harkness
content: Malkavian Neonate. Grows 'Magic Mushrooms' (Hallucinogens). Wears a 'Neurological Specialist's Outfit'. Investigated Mallori Mayhem's research.

title: Harpy
content: The arbiter of social status and scandal. They maintain the ledger of boons, announce who is 'in' or 'out' of favor, and punish social faux pas with status bans like 'Vulgar' or 'Disgraced'.

title: Harpy Sister Tiffany
content: Malkavian Ancilla and Harpy. A former nun and civil rights organizer who came to Asheville in 1992 to help Kindred adapt to the Camarilla.

title: Hattie McCloud (Deceased)
content: Malkavian Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Dec 7, 2024. Owner of the Rabbit Motel. Known for 'special vintages' of blood.

title: Helen Wheels
content: Gangrel Neonate. Drives a car customized for street racing. Has extensive lab equipment.

title: Helen's Bridge
content: A haunted bridge at Zealandia. The site where the witch Helen committed suicide to trap the Methuselah Judeculla. It is a synched leyline and a gathering place for ghosts.

title: Herald
content: A messenger of the Prince. They deliver proclamations, summons, and warnings to the Kindred of the city. In some courts, this role is merged with the Harpy or Seneschal.

title: Highland Hospital
content: The site of the 1948 fire used to cover up Zelda Fitzgerald's embrace. A location of historical trauma.

title: Honorable (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Individuals must expend a positive status to openly accuse you of lying. Only one spend required to bypass this, even if you have multiple Honorable traits.

title: Honorable (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Remain in a scene you would otherwise be politically forced to leave. Immune to the spend bonus of Abiding Status in that instance.

title: Hound
content: A slang term or official title for a Deputy Sheriff. They assist the Sheriff in patrolling the domain and subduing criminals.

title: Howitzer Prime
content: 8th Gen Tzimisce of Murder Piñata. A monster who turned their body into a weapon.

title: Humanity
content: The moral code that keeps the Beast at bay. Vampires must maintain their connection to their human nature or risk falling to the Beast and becoming a mindless monster (Wight).

title: Hunter
content: Mortals who have discovered the existence of monsters and sworn to destroy them. The Second Inquisition is a global network of hunters using government intelligence and black ops.

title: Ignoblis Ritae
content: The Low Rituals of the Sabbat. Custom rituals created by individual packs to bond them together. Unique to each pack.

title: Imperator
content: A rare military title for the supreme commander of the Camarilla's forces during times of great war. Karsh is the most famous Imperator.

title: Imperator Karsh
content: The Warlord of the Camarilla who vanished in 2023, leaving a power vacuum in the military leadership.

title: Inconnu
content: A mysterious sect of ancient vampires who have withdrawn from the Jyhad to seek Golconda. They monitor the other sects but rarely intervene.

title: Industrial Revolution
content: The era that allowed vampires to finally settle the 'urban valleys' of the mountains in numbers.

title: Influence: Bureaucratic Errors
content: A Level 3 Commercial Industry influence action. Used by E.W. Grove to create a grant program for fire suppression systems.

title: Influence: Free Travel
content: A Level 1 Transportation/Underworld influence action. Allows for secure movement between cities or locations without tracking.

title: Influence: Illegal Favors
content: A Level 3 Underworld/Street influence action. Used to acquire contraband (guns, drugs, burner phones).

title: Influence: No Party Crashers
content: A Level 5 influence action used to secure a location from mortal interference (police, fire, nosey neighbors).

title: Influence: Smooth Over
content: A Level 4 News Media influence action. Used to spin a story or suppress a Masquerade breach in the press.

title: Initial XP
content: The Experience Points provided at character creation to customize a character. In this system, typically involves assigning attributes (7/5/3), skills, and backgrounds.

title: Inner Circle
content: The secretive ruling body of the entire Camarilla. Composed of the eldest members of each clan, they meet every 13 years in Venice to set global policy and appoint Justicars.

title: Inquisitor
content: A member of the Sabbat Inquisition. They investigate infernalism and treason within the sect. They have the authority to accuse and try even high-ranking leaders.

title: Isabella María
content: Banu Haqim Primogen. Goes by 'Izzy'. Recently discovered her Sabbat associations and moved in with Wiebke. Wears a 'Mazel cocktail'.

title: Ishtarri
content: A Laibon lineage (and Toreador bloodline) of diplomats, spies, and hedonists. They are known for their beauty and dual nature.

title: Item: Abyssal Ink
content: A consumable item used by Lasombra (Rio) for rituals or powers. 5 uses per jar.

title: Item: Blood Wine
content: A consumable item created by Dr. Elezar and The Knight. Restores blood/vitae. 16 points of blood per bottle.

title: Item: D-Tryptophan
content: A chemical compound possessed by Wyatt Alston. Likely used for sleep inducement or tampering with mortals/blood.

title: Item: Foil Mana Crypt
content: A playset of rare Magic: The Gathering cards owned by Puck. Classified as 'Flashy'.

title: Item: Frankencar
content: A vehicle owned by Pretty Boy Slim. Flashy and cobbled together, likely with high performance stats.

title: Item: Hattie's Key
content: A unique item held by Sariah. Likely opens something related to the deceased Primogen Hattie McCloud (Rabbit Motel?).

title: Item: Hurdy Gurdy
content: A superior musical instrument owned by Nito. Adds dice to Performance checks.

title: Item: Obsidian Pendulum
content: An item customized for Science (Psychology) and Dementation, owned by Harold. Used for hypnosis or diagnosis.

title: Item: Origami Lion
content: A flavor item held by Faustus. Represents artistic skill or a specific message.

title: Item: PISS Keychain
content: A flashy keychain owned by Danny Reeves with gold/silver stars and glowing beads spelling 'PISS'.

title: Jess Thomas
content: 10th Gen Setite of Cast and Crew. Sufferer of anxiety.

title: Johnny Caper
content: 11th Gen Malkavian Abbot of Yahtzee Bitch. Bully.

title: Judge Inquisitor
content: A high-ranking Inquisitor authorized to convene tribunals and pass judgment on suspected traitors or infernalists.

title: Judeculla
content: A Methuselah (likely Salubri or Baali) trapped beneath the mountains of WNC. His influence is kept at bay by Helen's sacrifice. The source of much local magical turbulence.

title: Judeculla Rock
content: An ancient site of power in the mountains. Linked to the Salubri lineage and Saulot.
keywords: ancient,ancient site,judeculla rock,location,lore,magic,magic location,mountain mystery,noddist lore,salubri,saulot

title: Judicial Conclave
content: A high-level Camarilla court meeting to decide major laws or judge high-profile cases (like the Red List).

title: Julie d’Aubigny (La Maupin)
content: Historical figure cited as the 'vibe' for Tallula Donegan.

title: Juliet Parr (Justicar)
content: The Malkavian Justicar. Sheriff of London. Presiding over the 2025 Conclave regarding Kemintiri.

title: June 2025 Praxis Shift
content: The specific date when Prince Daveed Fourié claimed Praxis, resulting in the shuffling of Elysium locations (opening Grove Arcade, closing the Arboretum).

title: Justicar
content: The supreme judges and enforcers of the Camarilla, elected by the Inner Circle. They have the power to overrule Princes and command Archons. There is one for each Camarilla clan.

title: Justicar Basillia
content: Gangrel Justicar. Rose to power after the Gangrel rejoined the Tower. Suspected traitor by some.

title: Justicar Cock Robin
content: Nosferatu Justicar. Returned to the position in 2024 after Warwick's ousting.

title: Justicar Juliet Parr
content: Malkavian Justicar. Sheriff of London. Orchestrated the Setite amnesty offer.

title: Justicar Lucinde
content: Ventrue Justicar and Red Alastor. Effectively filling the role of Imperator.

title: Justicar Madame Guil
content: Toreador Justicar. Known for ruthlessness and executing untouchable Elders. Tallula's ally.

title: Justicar Tegyrius
content: Banu Haqim Justicar. Masterminded the clan's entry into the Camarilla.

title: Justicar Theo Bell
content: Brujah Justicar. Famous Archon who killed Hardestadt. Controversial but popular.

title: Justicar Ulugh Begh
content: The Tremere Justicar, recently appointed to replace Anastasz di Zagreb. He has taken a hardline stance against the Sabbat and is rumored to be critical of the Asheville domain's 'lax' history with the Sword of Caine. His Archon, Ferrum Civis, was recently destroyed in Asheville.

title: K-Blur ('Keebler')
content: A Knocker Changeling who runs a distribution warehouse in Asheville. Primary contact for the local Fae.

title: Kamut
content: A specific term for a pack comprised entirely of Black Hand operatives.

title: Kaymakli
content: The underground city in Turkey where Cappadocius held the 'Feast of Folly', sealing thousands of his 'unworthy' childer in the tunnels to starve or fall to the Beast.

title: Kemintiri (Red List)
content: The subject of the upcoming 2025 Judicial Conclave in London. The conclave will debate her removal from the #1 spot on the Red List.

title: Ken Dances
content: Reclusive Nosferatu Neonate and host of the pirate radio show 'The Weather'. He has not been seen at a Gather in decades, yet everyone knows his voice.

title: Keeper E.W. Grove
content: The Ventrue Keeper of Elysium and a legendary architect. He is the mastermind behind the Grove Park Inn and the Grove Arcade. He faked his death in 1927 and has a complicated history involving a betrayal of Prince Evander to the Sabbat in 1914, before defecting back to the Camarilla with Tallula in 1991.

title: Keeper of Elysium
content: The court officer responsible for the physical safety and maintenance of Elysium. They have the authority to confiscate weapons and expel troublemakers from the safe zone.
keywords: camarilla,elysium,elysium guard,event planner,guardian,host,keeper,keeper of elysium,pacifist enforcer,safety officer,title

title: Keeper of the Code
content: A title sometimes given to a vampire (often a Priest or Priscus) renowned for their knowledge of the Code of Milan and Sabbat law.

title: Kiasyd
content: The 'Weirdlings'. A Sabbat bloodline created from Lasombra experimentation with Fae blood. They are tall, pale scholars who study the Abyss and Arcadia.

title: Killswitch
content: 8th Gen Banu Haqim member of Hushed Puppies. Fighter.

title: Kindred
content: The term vampires use for themselves. Implies they are all family (descended from Caine).

title: Kindred Involvement (1888)
content: The start of significant vampire activity in WNC.

title: Kine
content: The Kindred term for mortals/humans. Literally 'cattle'.

title: King Leopold Langora
content: The Satyr King of the Unseelie Court in Asheville. Took power during the 2020 pandemic. His primary goal is to keep the Changelings hidden from the vampire war.

title: Knight Inquisitor
content: The martial arm of the Inquisition. They hunt down those accused by the Judges and drag them to trial (or destroy them if they resist).

title: Knights of the Moon
content: A faction of Malkavians who resisted the Great Prank. They retain the discipline of Dominate and often manifest insanity as cold sociopathy rather than manic delusion.

title: Koldunic Sorcery
content: Elemental blood magic practiced by Tzimisce (especially Sabbat). Tied to the spirits of the land (Kupala).

title: Laibon
content: The vampires of Africa. They possess distinct lineages (legacies) and govern themselves under the Ebony Kingdom, separate from the Camarilla and Sabbat.

title: Land of the Sky
content: The poetic moniker for the Domain of Asheville.

title: Land of the Sky Falls (1914)
content: The conquest of Asheville by the Sabbat.

title: Lasombra Magister
content: An honorary title for a Lasombra who has mastered the shadows and the games of politics.

title: Lextalionis
content: The Law of Retaliation. The code that allows for the Blood Hunt. Eye for an eye.

title: Lhiannan
content: A rare, druidic bloodline of the Gangrel (or independent) linked to spirit magic (Ogham). They are hunted and nearly extinct.

title: Liaison
content: A vampire appointed to communicate between different packs or factions within a city to ensure unity.

title: Lineage
content: The genealogy of a vampire, tracing back to the Antediluvian. Ventrue and Lasombra place immense value on reciting and documenting lineage.

title: Lines and Veils
content: Safety mechanics for the game. Lines are hard limits, Veils are fade-to-black.

title: Loresheet
content: A background mechanic allowing characters to buy into specific metaplot elements (e.g., 'Descendant of Hardestadt', 'Veteran of the Sabbat War').

title: Loyal (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: If you receive 'Warned', this status is stripped instead of applying the Negative Status. (Sacrificial shield).

title: Loyal (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Acquire one piece of equipment or general info on short notice via NPC minions (5 min delay). Cannot be secret info or unique items.

title: Loyalist (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who believes in absolute freedom and rejects the hierarchy of Regents and Cardinals. They follow Caine's example of answering to no one.

title: Loyalists
content: A Sabbat faction that believes in absolute freedom. They reject hierarchy and only obey Caine's direct commands (which are none).

title: Lucas Tractor
content: Neonate Nosferatu. Currently off-field.

title: Lucinde (Justicar)
content: The Ventrue Justicar and Alastor. One of the most powerful Kindred in the Camarilla.

title: Lucien Blake
content: Ductus of Yule Tied. 8th Gen Lasombra Traditionalist. Bitter about his position and resentful of Zelda Fitzgerald's art.

title: Lucien Blake (Bishop)
content: Lasombra. The Sabbat Bishop of Spirituality. A 'Book of Nod thumping evangelist' who distributes Chick tracts.

title: Lupine
content: The Kindred term for Werewolves. Mortal enemies of vampires. They are viewed as savage demons who guard the wild places. A single Lupine can often destroy a whole coterie of vampires.

title: Lupine War
content: The ongoing conflict between Asheville Kindred and the Garou, flaring up in 1900 and again in 2024.

title: Madlad
content: Deceased Pander of Yahtzee Bitch. Loose cannon.

title: Magda Doluda (Deceased)
content: Banu Haqim Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Dec 7, 2024. Safeguarded the Ukrainian population of Asheville.

title: Mage
content: A human with the power to alter reality (True Magick). The Tremere were once Mages who lost their avatars to become vampires. Mages are unpredictable and dangerous.

title: Mallori Mayhem
content: A notorious Sabbat pack leader (Malkavian antitribu) known for chaotic and violent displays.

title: Mama Jane Bratovich
content: Ductus of Southern Hospitality. 8th Gen Bratovich Tzimisce. Protective matriarch of her twisted family.

title: Manfred von Kassel
content: Lasombra Ancilla and the current Sheriff of Greater Asheville. He is responsible for the martial defense of the city. As a Lasombra in the Camarilla, he faces constant suspicion but has proven his loyalty through effective enforcement of the Traditions.

title: Marco Asensio
content: Lasombra Pack Priest of 150 Guns.

title: Marcus Thorne
content: Tremere Apprentice of the Third Circle in the Triangle. An expert on the history of Washington D.C. and occult artifacts. Quiet, bookish, and politically naive.

title: Maria Ramirez
content: Former Lasombra Primogen. Defected in 1991. Missing as of Dec 2024.

title: Marko (Abbot)
content: 11th Gen Setite Abbot of The Satyr Boys.

title: Marrow Milker
content: 6th Gen Kiasyd Elder. A monster of the Sabbat residing with the Yule Tied pack.

title: Mars Hill Library
content: The massive collection of heretical lore kept by Baron Schaefer in Mars Hill.

title: Mars Hill University
content: The stronghold of Baron Schaefer. Houses a library of forbidden and heretical texts not permitted in the Camarilla.
keywords: anarch,anarch territory,baron schaefer,library,location,mars hill,neutral ground,occult research,university

title: Martin Simpson
content: 10th Gen Brujah of Cast and Crew. Former security guard.

title: Masquerade Breach
content: Any action that reveals the existence of vampires to mortals. Using disciplines in public, showing fangs, or getting caught on camera. Results in swift punishment.

title: Maximum Fatality
content: A violent Brujah/biker pack based in Canton. Led by Rex 'The Dick' Morst. Eager for war with the Camarilla.

title: Mental Focus: Intelligence
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., forensics).

title: Mental Focus: Perception
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., searching a room).

title: Mental Focus: Wits
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., remembering details).

title: Mercy Merriman
content: Brujah Elder and Whip. A fiery orator and seasoned warrior of the clan of the Learned. She guides the younger Brujah and ensures their passion is directed towards the enemies of the Tower rather than its foundations.

title: Merit: Arcane
content: A supernatural quality that makes the vampire difficult to remember or record. Photos blur, files get lost, and people forget their face. Common among high-level NPCs.

title: Merit: Architect of the Tower
content: Innate Status: Architect.

title: Merit: Artist's Blessing
content: A Toreador-specific merit (1 point). Grants 3 free dots of a Craft or Performance skill and raises the cap on those skills to 7.

title: Merit: Personal Cult
content: A Setite-specific merit (1 point). Grants additional Background points that must be assigned to Allies, Contacts, or Herd, representing a fanatic cult.

title: Merit: Prestigious Sire
content: Innate Status: Loyal.

title: Merit: Protean Blood
content: A Gangrel-specific merit (1 point). Allows the user to occasionally activate Protean powers without spending blood.

title: Merit: Rugged
content: A physical merit representing tough skin or dense bones. Reduces damage from physical attacks.

title: Merit: Shape of Beast's Wrath
content: A Werewolf-specific merit (or Gangrel). Allows the user to shift into the Crinos (war form) for devastating combat bonuses.

title: Merit: Slippery Customer
content: A merit that makes the user incredibly hard to grapple or restrain.

title: Merit: Szlachta
content: A Tzimisce-specific merit (2 points). Allows the vampire to fleshcraft Retainers into twisted war-ghouls with combat bonuses.

title: Merit: Versatile
content: Allows a character to use a specific Ability with a different Attribute than usual (e.g., Strength + Intimidation instead of Charisma).

title: Merriam Walker
content: Ductus of Old Guard. 8th Gen Ventrue antitribu (Crusader). A terrifying warrior and architect loyal to Tallula.

title: Merriam Walker (Bishop)
content: Ventrue antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Security in the new Archdiocese.

title: Methuselah
content: A vampire of the 4th or 5th generation, usually thousands of years old. They are rarely seen in open court and are feared for their godlike power.

title: Methuselah's Thirst
content: The curse that ancient vampires can no longer sustain themselves on human blood and must feed on the vitae of other vampires.

title: Michael (Bishop)
content: 9th Gen Malkavian Bishop of Prophecy. Member of The Satyr Boys pack.

title: Michael Valentine (Keeper)
content: The Brujah Keeper of Elysium appointed in August 2025. He introduced the 'Steward' system for Elysium staff.

title: Miles Wilkins (Deceased)
content: Toreador Neonate and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. Rumored to have paid for his seat. Obsessed with fantasy football.

title: Miss Kitty
content: Bishop of Resources and member of 150 Guns. 12th Gen Nosferatu. An 'art personality' and influencer.

title: Moe Schmoe
content: Banu Haqim Ancilla. Currently inactive. Known for using Silver and Incendiary ammo.

title: Monalisa
content: The slang term for the act of destroying a vampire's face or identity using Vicissitude or physical damage, often done by Sabbat to mocks the beautiful Toreador. (Contextual slang).

title: Monomacy
content: The Sabbat rite of ritual duel. Used to settle grievances or challenge leadership positions. The winner is often entitled to diablerize the loser.

title: Moongate
content: A magical portal or phenomenon associated with Judeculla Rock and the bridge. Helen's suicide 'cinched' the leyline to close it.

title: Morgan 9's Doan
content: Gangrel Ancilla and Enforcer. A wilderness scout and combatant who patrols the borders of the city, intercepting threats before they reach the urban center.

title: Murder Piñata
content: A hyper-violent Sabbat pack dedicated to the destruction of Prince Tallula and her 'traitor' regime. Led by the Nosferatu Twist, they specialize in psychological warfare and physical devastation. Rumors suggest a deep connection between Twist and the Camarilla Sheriff Oliver.

title: Nagaraja
content: A bloodline of flesh-eating necromancers. They possess sharp teeth and must consume human flesh in addition to blood.

title: Nautilus
content: 9th Gen Giovanni of Cast and Crew. Curmudgeon.

title: Necromancy: Path of Ash
content: The path focusing on the Shroud (the barrier between worlds) and the Shadowlands.

title: Necromancy: Path of Bone
content: The path focusing on corpses, zombies, and the physical remains of death.

title: Necromancy: Path of the Sepulchre
content: The path focusing on communicating with and commanding ghosts. Used by Giovanni and some Tremere/Lasombra.

title: Neonate
content: A young vampire (typically <50 years active) who has been released/acknowledged but has not yet earned the rank of Ancilla.

title: Nictuku
content: Monstrous vampires created by the Nosferatu Antediluvian to hunt down and destroy his own clan. They are the boogeymen of the Sewer Rats.

title: Nights of Turmoil
content: The period in recent history (approx 1999-2010) marked by the appearance of the Red Star, the Week of Nightmares, and the Gehenna Crusade. Changed the political landscape significantly.

title: Nito
content: Tremere Neonate and Primogen. A young Warlock thrust into a position of power. He deals with the magical threats to the city, including the Sabbat's Koldunic sorcery and the recent disturbances in the ghostly shroud.

title: Noble (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Award 'Acclaimed' or 'Loyal' without expending. Target limited to one from you at a time.

title: Noble (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Give the Negative Status 'Vulgar' to an individual who caused significant offense.

title: Noddist
content: A scholar of the Book of Nod. They study the lore of Caine and the Antediluvians, seeking signs of Gehenna.

title: Noddism
content: The study of the Book of Nod and the history of Caine. Central to Sabbat theology.

title: Noddists
content: Scholars who study the Book of Nod and Caine. Often associated with the Sabbat, but also found among curious Camarilla (like those seeking the Schaefer Archive).

title: Nomad Pack
content: A Sabbat pack that travels from city to city, acting as messengers, scouts, or reinforcements. They have no permanent domain.

title: North Carolina Arboretum
content: A secondary Elysium established in 2001, featuring extensive gardens and an arena designated for ritual combat and duels. It allows for the resolution of grievances in a controlled environment under the supervision of the Master of Elysium.

title: Old Guard
content: A Sabbat pack of Tallula loyalists who refused to defect with her but remain strangely protective of her interests. Based in Hendersonville, they are led by Merriam Walker (Ventrue antitribu). They represent the complex web of loyalty and betrayal that defines the Asheville Sabbat.

title: Ominous (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Grants highest level of command. Almost everything is allowable.

title: Ominous (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: When expending status to give Disgraced/Forsaken, it can ONLY be removed by another Inner Circle member.

title: Ophelia
content: Malkavian Neonate and Whip. A cryptic and insightful voice among the Lunatics. She helps interpret the madness of her clanmates and channel their insights into useful intelligence for the Primogen.

title: Ophelia's Sheriffdom
content: The brief period in early 2025 where Ophelia (Malkavian) served as Sheriff after Oliver's disappearance and before Manfred took the role.

title: Operation: Fight Club
content: A rumored (and denied) Symbel Ordeal for combat that Jack Greenlimb teased in Feb 2025.

title: Opposed Challenge
content: A test between two characters (PC vs PC or PC vs NPC). Both parties form a test pool and throw Rock-Paper-Scissors.

title: Osebo
content: A Laibon lineage of warriors. They are often associated with the Beast and serve as the guardians of the Ebony Kingdom.

title: Osiris
content: A vampire who builds a cult of mortals around them for blood and worship.

title: Pack
content: The Sabbat equivalent of a coterie, but bound by the Vaulderie and fanatical loyalty. They live and fight as a single unit.

title: Pack Priest
content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack. They conduct the Auctoritas Ritae (like the Vaulderie) and ensure the pack remains loyal to the sect and true to their Path of Enlightenment.

title: Palla Grande
content: The Grand Ball. A major Sabbat festival held on Halloween (or Walpurgis Night). A mockery of Camarilla court involving excess and a blood feast.

title: Palla Grande Offensive (2025)
content: A coordinated strike by the Independent Alliance against Sabbat strongholds (Atlanta, Savannah) on Halloween 2025.

title: Pander
content: The Clanless of the Sabbat. Led by Joseph Pander, they fought for recognition as a legitimate 'clan' within the sect.

title: Pander (Title)
content: A member of the Pander bloodline (Clanless Sabbat). They have fought for and won the right to be treated as a legitimate tribe within the sect.

title: Panders
content: The Clanless of the Sabbat. Unlike Camarilla Caitiff, they have established themselves as a legitimate political tribe within the Sword of Caine, led by Joseph Pander.

title: Patrol Duty
content: The explicit expectation that a Clan must physically defend their assigned Feeding Territory from Masquerade breaches and interlopers. Failure to patrol can result in the Prince stripping the territory or Hunters establishing a foothold.

title: Path Follower
content: A vampire who has formally adopted a Path of Enlightenment, abandoning Humanity. They are viewed as more 'evolved' by the sect.

title: Path of Caine
content: A Sabbat path focusing on emulating Caine, the first vampire. Adherents seek to master their vampiric nature, learn blood sorcery, and diablerize to gain power closer to Caine.

title: Path of Cathari
content: A path of vice and excess. Adherents believe vampires are creatures of the material world and should indulge in every pleasure and sin to trap the soul in the body.

title: Path of Death and the Soul
content: A path practiced by Necromancers. It involves a detached, scientific study of death, souls, and entropy. Adherents are cold and emotionless.

title: Path of Enlightenment
content: An alternative moral code to Humanity, used by Sabbat and Elders to control the Beast. Examples: Path of Caine, Path of Lilith, Path of Night.

title: Path of Feral Heart
content: A path for those who embrace the Beast. Adherents live as supreme predators, following the instincts of the wild. They are often Gangrel.

title: Path of Honorable Accord
content: The Path of Enlightenment Tallula followed before switching to Humanity in 2002.

title: Path of Lilith (Bahari)
content: A path that worships Lilith as the Dark Mother. Adherents seek wisdom through pain and suffering (giving and receiving). They are often enemies of Caine-worshippers.

title: Path of Metamorphosis
content: A Tzimisce path focused on evolving the body and soul through Vicissitude. Adherents view themselves as changing gods, discarding humanity for a higher state of being.

title: Path of Night
content: A Lasombra path. Adherents believe they are the shadows sent by God to punish sinners. They accept their role as monsters and rulers of the dark.

title: Path of Power and the Inner Voice
content: A path of absolute rule. Adherents believe that power justifies itself and that the strong must rule the weak. Common among Sabbat leaders (Bishops/Cardinals).

title: Pentex
content: A mega-corporation mentioned in 1888 history as working with George Vanderbilt. Enemy of the Garou.

title: Physical Focus: Dexterity
content: A character creation choice. Grants the ability to use one Dexterity-based combat maneuver (Burst of Speed, Disarm, Fighting Blind, Quick Draw) without cost once per combat.

title: Physical Focus: Stamina
content: A character creation choice. The character does not suffer wound penalties and cannot be Knocked Out or Knocked Down unless the attacker has a higher Physical attribute.

title: Physical Focus: Strength
content: A character creation choice. Grants the ability to use one Strength-based combat maneuver (Disarm, Grapple, Knock Down, Pierce the Heart) without cost once per combat.

title: Pieter van Dorn
content: A Brujah traitor to the Triangle Chantry. A former anti-apartheid poet who defects to the Anarchs/Setites. Currently missing.

title: Pip Riviere
content: Toreador. Full name 'Pieretta Riviere'. Carries a Stylish Accurate Pistol. Active in Law Enforcement influence.

title: Pontifex
content: A high-ranking Tremere leader overseeing a vast geographic region (consisting of several domains). They answer to the Council of Seven.

title: Pop Eye
content: 10th Gen Malkavian Priest of Hushed Puppies. Freak.

title: Position: Alastor
content: Abiding Status: Commander.

title: Position: Ancilla
content: Abiding Status: Confirmed.

title: Position: Archon
content: Abiding Status: Commander, Noble.

title: Position: Elder
content: Abiding Status: Confirmed, Established, Privileged.

title: Position: Harpy
content: Abiding Status: Prominent, Noble, Guardian.

title: Position: Imperator
content: Abiding Status: Ascendant, Authority, Commander.

title: Position: Inner Circle
content: Abiding Status: Ascendant, Authority, Commander, Ominous.

title: Position: Justicar
content: Abiding Status: Ascendant, Authority, Commander.

title: Position: Keeper of Elysium
content: Abiding Status: Enforcer, Guardian.

title: Position: Primogen
content: Abiding Status: Noble.

title: Position: Prince
content: Abiding Status: Authority, Commander, Sovereign.

title: Position: Scourge
content: Abiding Status: Enforcer.

title: Position: Seneschal
content: Abiding Status: Noble. Also Authority (only when Prince is not in attendance).

title: Position: Sheriff
content: Abiding Status: Enforcer, Privileged.

title: Position: Whip
content: Abiding Status: Noble (only when Primogen is not in attendance).

title: Praised (from Disgraced)
content: Mechanic: Anyone who publicly insults a Disgraced character gains the Fleeting Status 'Praised'. Multiple people can gain this from one target, but only once per target per game.

title: Praised (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: None.

title: Praised (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Claim a small favor (Trivial Boon level) from any Accepted sect member not already in your debt.

title: Praxis
content: The right to rule a domain. A Prince 'claims Praxis' to establish their authority. It must be supported by the Primogen and the capacity to enforce it.

title: Predator Type
content: A categorization of how a vampire feeds (e.g., Siren, Alleycat, Osiris). Determines their hunting style and initial bonuses.

title: Premascine
content: A Giovanni bloodline that acts as a throwback to the Cappadocians. They can learn the Mortis Path of Necromancy and often appear corpse-like.

title: Pretty Boy Slim
content: Toreador Ancilla and Deputy Sheriff. A combat-capable Toreador who defies the stereotype of the effete artist. He assists Sheriff Manfred in the physical defense of the Masquerade.

title: Pretty Boy Slim (PBS)
content: Toreador Ancilla Deputy Sheriff. Drives a 'Franken-car' (Flashy). Uses Auto repair tools. Defies the 'artsy' stereotype with combat prowess.

title: Pretty Peggy Sue Bratovich
content: 10th Gen Bratovich. The 'cultured' face of the hillbilly family.

title: Priest (Pack Priest)
content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack. They lead the Vaulderie and Rites of Monomacy.

title: Priest (Sabbat)
content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack. Responsible for conducting Ritae and maintaining morale.

title: Primogen
content: The council of advisors to the Prince, usually representing the interests of their respective clans. They are the elders who check the Prince's power and advocate for their lineage.
