title: Primogen Council
content: The collective body of Primogen. They meet to vote on domain issues, advise the Prince, and in some cities, elect the Prince.

title: Prince (Praxis Holder)
content: The supreme ruler of a Camarilla domain. They hold the right of Praxis, the authority to create progeny, judge disputes, and call Blood Hunts. Their word is law within the city limits.

title: Prince Daveed
content: The current ruler of the city, strict adherent to the Masquerade.

title: Prince Ginevra Bellecourt
content: The Ventrue Prince of Charlotte, NC ('The Golden Tower'). A 7th Generation Elder who has ruled for over a century. Known for her cruel sense of humor, air hockey championship skills, and rigid social hierarchy.

title: Prince Iago
content: The ruler of Knoxville, TN ('The Marble Tyrant'). A tyrannical Prince who keeps his domain under strict martial law. He is a rival to the Asheville domain and a threat to the Anarch Free State.

title: Prince Malphas
content: The Prince of the Triangle (Raleigh/Durham/Chapel Hill). A Tremere Elder who acts as an 'uncle' figure to many. He maintains a stable, academic domain and corresponds with Tallula Donegan.

title: Prince Tallula Donegan
content: The current Toreador Prince of Greater Asheville. Formerly the Sabbat Archbishop of Appalachia, she defected to the Camarilla in 1991. Known for her ruthlessness and love of fine things.

title: Prince's Court
content: The collective body of officers and acknowledged Kindred who attend the Prince's gatherings. It is the center of social and political life.

title: Priscus
content: An advisor in the Sabbat with great status but no temporal command. They advise the Consistory.

title: Privileged (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Cannot be openly/effectively accused of lying unless accuser has Privileged, Commander, Triumphant, or Authority.

title: Privileged (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Give the Negative Status 'Vulgar'.

title: Prominent (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Award 'Honorable' or 'Courteous'. Target limited to one from you at a time.

title: Prominent (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Exile. Target must physically leave the scene (room/area) for 10 minutes. If they refuse, they gain 'Disgraced'. Cannot be used in combat.

title: Puck Burbage
content: Toreador Ancilla and Primogen. A prominent artist and socialite, Puck manages the artistic soul of the city and the preservation of the Toreador's influence. They are deeply involved in the social maneuvering of Elysium.

title: Pyramid
content: The rigid hierarchical structure of Clan Tremere. Every member has a specific rank and superior they must obey.

title: Quickdraw Quinine Callahan
content: 9th Gen Lasombra Pack Priest of Murder Piñata. Fanatic Corsair.

title: Rabbit Motel
content: A boutique motel run by the late Hattie McCloud. Known for its kitchen and serving kindred clientele.

title: Rafferty
content: Ventrue Ancilla and Primogen. A business magnate and enforcer of the Ventrue ethic of leadership. He ensures the financial stability of the domain and the adherence to the protocols of lineage and dignity.

title: Railroad Expansion
content: Historical driver of Kindred population growth in the late 19th century mountains.

title: Ravnos
content: A clan of tricksters and illusionists. They were nearly wiped out in 2004 during the 'Week of Nightmares' when their Antediluvian woke and was nuked. Survivors are nomads. Their power is Chimerstry (illusions).

title: Recruiter
content: A Sabbat vampire who specializes in identifying potential shovelheads or true recruits for the sect.

title: Red List (Anathema)
content: The 'Most Wanted' list of the Camarilla. Vampires who have committed crimes so heinous (usually infernalism, massive breaches, or ancient crimes) that their global destruction is mandated.
keywords: criminals,enemies of state,kill on sight,most wanted

title: Red Star Shines (1999)
content: The omen of Gehenna.

title: Regent
content: The spiritual and temporal leader of the entire Sabbat sect. Believed to rule in Caine's stead.

title: Regent (Tremere)
content: The leader of a local Tremere Chantry. They govern the Warlocks of the city and report to the Lord or Pontifex of the region.

title: Religious Trauma
content: A specific theme explored in the game due to the setting's Sabbat history, acknowledging that much of the Sabbat's iconography and control mechanisms are twisted from Catholic trappings.

title: Renovations (Grove Arcade)
content: The official reason given by Prince Daveed Fourié for stripping the Grove Arcade of its Elysium status on December 3rd, 2025. Likely a euphemism for a security breach or political shift.

title: Revenant
content: A rare type of ghoul born to a ghoul family (like the Bratovitch). They produce their own weak vitae and are naturally long-lived without needing constant feeding. Used by the Sabbat and Tzimisce.

title: Rex 'The Dick' Morst
content: Ductus of Maximum Fatality. 8th Gen Brujah. A bully who hates Tallula for defecting. Bishop of War.

title: Rex the Dick (Destroyed)
content: Brujah antitribu. Former Sabbat Bishop of Pride. Slain June 7, 2025. Ran a biker gang in Canton.

title: Ridgefangs
content: Tallula Donegan's original Sabbat pack. Disbanded/Defected in 1991. Known for their nomadic warring against the Camarilla.

title: Rio de la Cruz
content: Lasombra Ancilla. A necromancer who uses 'Abyssal Ink' and 'Abyssal Ichor'. Recently quested to create lenses from a Timber Baron's eyes.

title: Ritual: Blood Wine
content: A Thaumaturgy ritual to store vitae in wine. Known by Dr. Elezar and The Knight.

title: Ritual: Communicate with Kindred Sire
content: Allows telepathic communication with one's sire. Used by Dr. Elezar to talk to his 'mother'.

title: Ritual: Deflection of Wooden Doom
content: A common ritual making the caster resistant to staking.

title: Ritual: Pavis of Foul Presence
content: A ritual that reverses the effects of Presence used against the caster.

title: Ritual: Wake with Morning's Freshness
content: Allows a vampire to wake up during the day instantly if disturbed.

title: Ritual: Ward vs. Lupines
content: A ritual creating a barrier that burns werewolves. Essential for Asheville's borders.

title: Ritualist
content: A vampire skilled in the performance of Ignoblis Ritae.

title: Roach
content: Blood Brother pack (Stock 3). Members of the Sabbat.

title: Robert Fraser
content: Gangrel Ancilla and Primogen. He represents the Beasts of the domain. His primary concern is the encroaching threat of the Lupines and the security of the rural borders of Greater Asheville.

title: Rötschreck
content: The Red Fear. The terror induced by fire or sunlight. It causes an immediate, panic-fueled flight reflex in vampires.

title: Sabbat Coin ('bbat coin)
content: A rare gold coin from the Dahlonega Mint, used by local Sabbat and some savvy independents as an informal currency. One coin is roughly equivalent to a Minor Boon.

title: Sabbat Coin (Item)
content: Rare gold coins from the Dahlonega Mint used as currency by local Sabbat. Worth roughly a Minor Boon.

title: Sabbat Join the Fight (1910)
content: The Sabbat's entry into the local conflict.

title: Sadie
content: Former Brujah Primogen. An Elder who led the council. Ashes recovered Jan 2025.

title: Sadie (Deceased)
content: Brujah Elder and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. Former Harpy of Charlotte who moved to Asheville in 2001.

title: Salubri
content: A nearly extinct clan of healers and warriors with a third eye. They were destroyed by the Tremere (who diablerized their founder, Saulot). They are hunted as 'soul eaters' by Camarilla propaganda.

title: Salubri Healers (Lambs)
content: The original caste of the Salubri clan. Persecuted by the Tremere, they seek Golconda and practice the healing art of Obeah.

title: Salubri Warriors
content: The caste of Salubri who turned to war to survive. They joined the Sabbat and practice the discipline of Valeren (burning righteous fire).

title: Samedi
content: A bloodline of rotting necromancers. They resemble zombies and practice Thanatosis (decay). They often work as mercenaries.

title: Sanctioned (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: None.

title: Sanctioned (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Allows a specifically defined breach of one sect law without punishment. An exception granted by Authority.

title: Sandman
content: A vampire who feeds from sleeping victims.

title: Sariya Anderson
content: Ductus of the 'Yahtzee Bitch' Sabbat pack. A Pander architect who builds traps and fortifications.

title: Satyr Boys
content: A Sabbat pack of loyalists. Members include Michael (Malkavian Bishop), David (Brujah Ductus), Marko (Setite Abbot), Dwayne (Gangrel), and Star (Salubri).

title: Sawtooth Pete
content: 9th Gen Gangrel of Hushed Puppies. Bishop of Information. Former Cam Primogen.

title: Sawtooth Pete (Bishop)
content: Gangrel antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Resources. Former Camarilla Primogen who defected back to the Sword of Caine.

title: Saxon Braithwaite
content: Fledgeling Gangrel.

title: Scene Queen
content: A vampire who feeds from a specific subculture (goth, club, drug).

title: Schaefer Archive
content: The library of heretical texts held by Baron Schaefer at Mars Hill. Guarded by a Type-D Aegis.

title: Schaefer's Fiefdom
content: The autonomous Anarch domain centered around Mars Hill University. It is known for hosting a library of texts that would be destroyed by the Camarilla for their heretical or dangerous nature.

title: Schismatics
content: The faction of Banu Haqim that split from Alamut to join the Camarilla.

title: Schismatics Find a Seat (2000)
content: Banu Haqim entry to council.

title: Scholar
content: A pack role for the vampire who keeps the lore and knowledge of the pack (often the Priest, but not always).

title: SchreckNET
content: The former Nosferatu internet network. It was compromised by the NSA/Second Inquisition, leading to the destruction of many vampires. It is now strictly forbidden to use unencrypted digital comms for Kindred business.

title: SchreckNET 2.0
content: The attempt to rebuild the Nosferatu network after the SI crash. Heavily monitored and dangerous. 'xX_DarkRat_Xx' is a user.

title: Scout
content: A pack role for the vampire best suited to reconnaissance and stealth.

title: Scourge
content: A court official responsible for thinning the population of the domain. They hunt down Caitiff, unauthorized childer, and Thin-bloods to keep the vampire population sustainable and pure.

title: Second Inquisition
content: The modern threat of government hunters (FBI/NSA).

title: Seneschal
content: The Prince's right hand and administrator. They handle the boring details of ruling, manage schedules, and stand in for the Prince when they are unavailable.

title: Seneschal Big Ben
content: The Prince's right hand, a massive Elder of unknown clan (rumored Brujah). He defected with Tallula in 1991. Missing as of Dec 2024.

title: Seneschal Huy
content: The Nosferatu Seneschal of Charlotte. A Vietnamese Elder of the 7th Generation who spent decades in torpor after the Vietnam War. He deepened the Charlotte warrens and enforces the Prince's will with silent efficiency.

title: Seneschal's Whip
content: A rare title for an assistant specifically to the Seneschal, handling administrative enforcement rather than clan matters.

title: Seraph
content: One of the four supreme commanders of the Black Hand. They answer only to the Regent (and technically the Consistory, though this is debated).

title: Sermon of Caine
content: The Sabbat rite of reading from the Book of Nod to remind the pack of their history and holy purpose.

title: Servire Svetlana Volshebnik
content: Tremere Elder. Accompanied Tallula to Argentina as her Servire. Reported Tallula's betrayal and death but holds out hope for her survival.

title: Setites (Ministry)
content: A clan worshipping the god Set. They act as corrupters and tempters, trading in vice and secrets. They hate the light and are enemies of the other clans (mostly). They recently rebranded as 'The Ministry'.

title: Sheriff
content: The martial enforcer of the Prince's laws. They investigate crimes, hunt criminals, and lead the domain's defense in times of war. They often appoint Deputies (Hounds) to assist them.

title: Sheriff Oliver
content: Nosferatu Ancilla and Sheriff of the domain. Known for his grumpy demeanor and phrases like 'Start shit, get hit'. Missing as of Dec 2024.

title: Shimmer (Brujah)
content: Former Seneschal to Tallula in late 2024/early 2025. Destroyed by Tallula after a failed assassination/coup attempt.

title: Shovelhead
content: A slang term for a mass-embraced vampire, created by being drained, fed blood, hit with a shovel, and buried. If they claw their way out, they join the siege. Most die or are destroyed.

title: Siege Commander
content: A temporary title for the leader (often a Cardinal or Archbishop) directing a siege against a Camarilla city.

title: Sire
content: The vampire who created another. Under the Tradition of Accounting, they are responsible for their childe's education and behavior.

title: Sister Tiffany (Elder)
content: Malkavian Elder (acknowledged May 2025). A former nun and civil rights organizer who served as Harpy from 1992 to 2025. She resigned her post upon reaching Elder status.

title: Skill: Dodge
content: A skill used to evade attacks. A character with this skill can sacrifice their standard action to gain a +2 bonus to one Dodge test pool for the round.

title: Skill: Linguistics
content: For every dot in this skill, the character is fluent in one additional language. Without it, they only speak their native tongue.

title: Skill: Lore
content: A skill representing hidden supernatural knowledge. Each dot allows the player to choose a specific category (e.g., Clan Brujah, Noddist History).

title: Social Focus: Appearance
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., seduction).

title: Social Focus: Charisma
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., sweet-talking a group).

title: Social Focus: Manipulation
content: A character creation choice. May grant a +3 bonus to related non-power challenges or halve the time required for focus-related actions (e.g., spreading lies).

title: Sorcerer
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on blood magic.

title: Southern Hospitality
content: A Tzimisce pack (Bratovich family) based in Maggie Valley. Known for 'hillbilly horror' tactics.

title: Sovereign (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Award 'Courteous', 'Enforcer', or 'Loyal' without expending. Target limited to one from you at a time. Cannot be openly contradicted in your domain (unless Privileged/Authority).

title: Sovereign (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Give 'Sanctioned' or 'Forsaken' (Blood Hunt) in a single domain.

title: Spearman
content: A slang term (often derogatory) for a ghoul or low-ranking neonate used as cannon fodder or muscle.

title: Star
content: 9th Gen Salubri of The Satyr Boys. Enigma and Loyalist.

title: Star (Salubri)
content: A mysterious Sabbat Salubri antitribu member of the Satyr Boys. An enigma who fights for the Sword of Caine.

title: Static Challenge
content: A test against a fixed difficulty number set by the Storyteller (usually based on the complexity of the task). No opponent is involved.

title: Status
content: The currency of social standing in the Camarilla. Traits like 'Acknowledged', 'Ancilla', or 'Elder' define a vampire's rights and influence. Status is granted by the Prince and stripped by the Harpy.

title: Status Perfectus
content: The founding document of the Anarch Free States in California. It attempted to apply modern democratic principles to vampiric society, rejecting the feudal Prince system.

title: Status Quo
content: The Sabbat faction that seeks to maintain the current power structure of the sect (Lasombra/Tzimisce leadership).

title: Status Quo (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who supports the current balance of power (Lasombra/Tzimisce leadership) and the Code of Milan as it stands.

title: Status: Acclaimed
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Typically awarded by a Noble (Harpy, Seneschal, or Primogen of your own clan). Represents social praise and recognition.

title: Status: Architect
content: An Innate Status trait. Derived from the 'Architect of the Tower' Merit. Represents deep structural importance to the Camarilla.

title: Status: Ascendant
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by Justicars, Inner Circle members, or Imperators. Represents supreme authority.

title: Status: Authority
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by the Prince (and sometimes Seneschal/Justicars). Represents the right to rule and judge.

title: Status: Boonbreaker
content: The specific Negative Status given by a Harpy to those who fail to repay a debt. Equivalent to Disgraced.

title: Status: Commander
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by the Prince or higher officers (Justicar, Archon). Represents martial or executive command.

title: Status: Confirmed
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by any Ancilla of the Camarilla. Represents being a proven member of society.

title: Status: Courageous
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by a Commander or Authority. Represents bravery and martial capability.

title: Status: Courteous
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by Prominent (Harpy) or Sovereign (Prince). Represents impeccable etiquette and social grace.

title: Status: Defender
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by an Enforcer (Sheriff/Scourge/Keeper) or Authority. Represents a guardian role.

title: Status: Disgraced
content: A Negative Status trait. Awarded by a Guardian (Harpy/Keeper), refusal of Prominent effects, or breaking a Warned censure. Represents social pariah status.

title: Status: Enforcer
content: An Abiding Status (for Officers) or Fleeting Status (if deputized). Held by Sheriff, Scourge, Keeper, or deputies of the Sovereign/Commander. Represents law enforcement.

title: Status: Established
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by Elders. Represents age, tenure, and entrenched power.

title: Status: Favored
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by an Established (Elder). Represents being under an Elder's protection.

title: Status: Forsaken
content: A Negative Status trait. Given by Authority (Prince+). Represents a death sentence (Blood Hunt).

title: Status: Gallant
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Gained by fulfilling a boon to someone with 'Social Nobility'. Represents chivalry and honor.

title: Status: Guardian
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by Harpy or Keeper. Represents protection of social or physical norms.

title: Status: Honorable
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by Prominent (Harpy) or Authority (Prince). Represents personal integrity.

title: Status: Loyal
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by Noble, Prestigious Sire, Authority, or Commander. Represents dedication to the sect/domain.

title: Status: Noble
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by Primogen, Whip (acting), Harpy, or Seneschal. Represents high court standing.

title: Status: Ominous
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by the Inner Circle. Represents terrifying, absolute power.

title: Status: Praised
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Gained by publicly insulting a Disgraced character. Represents social approval for shunning pariahs.

title: Status: Privileged
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by Sheriff or Elder. Represents legal immunity and high standing.

title: Status: Profane
content: The specific Negative Status given by a Keeper of Elysium to those who violate the sanctity of the location.

title: Status: Prominent
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by the Harpy. Represents control over social standing.

title: Status: Sanctified
content: (Distinct from Sanctioned) Often refers to territory made holy or safe, though 'Sanctioned' is the specific status for allowed law-breaking.

title: Status: Sanctioned
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Awarded by Sovereign (Prince). Represents a legal exception.

title: Status: Sovereign
content: An Abiding Status trait. Held by the Prince. Represents absolute dominion over the territory.

title: Status: Triumphant
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Gained by killing a Forsaken (Blood Hunted) Kindred. Represents victory.

title: Status: Victorious
content: A Fleeting Status trait. Gained by winning a Symbel (Status contest). Represents winning.

title: Status: Victorious (Symbel)
content: The specific Fleeting Status awarded to the winner of a Symbel Ordeal. Allows the winner to refresh spent status.

title: Status: Vulgar
content: A Negative Status trait. Punished by Privileged (Sheriff) or Noble (Harpy/Seneschal/Primogen). Represents social faux pas.

title: Status: Warned
content: A Negative Status trait. Punished by Authority/Enforcer/Guardian or attacking an Elder. Represents a formal warning/probation.

title: Suspire
content: The final test in a vampire's journey to achieve Golconda. A moment of enlightenment.

title: Svetlana Volshebnik
content: Elder Tremere advisor to the court. Arrived in 1991 to oversee the domain's transition. Acts as a liaison but holds no voting seat.

title: Sweeper
content: An Anarch title for a vampire who introduces newcomers to the domain and ensures they know the local rules.

title: Symbel
content: A contest for status, the winner of which receives the 'Victorious' trait.

title: Symbel Ordeal
content: A formal contest or tournament used to determine status or appointments in the domain. Winners are often granted the status 'Victorious'.

title: Symon Constantine
content: Character who read cartomancy spreads for the domain. Participated in a Truth or Dare game that threatened E.W. Grove.

title: Tal'Mahe'Ra
content: The True Black Hand. A death cult of ancients operating from the Shadowlands. (Deep lore).

title: Technique
content: A unique power created by mixing two disciplines. Accessible to vampires with thinner blood (Neonates/Ancillae) who cannot learn Elder Powers.

title: Technique: Bullseye Shot
content: A combination of Auspex and Celerity. Allows the user to make a ranged attack with supernatural accuracy, ignoring cover and penalties. Used by Tallula Donegan.

title: Technique: Displacement Aura
content: A combination of Auspex and Obfuscate. The user appears to be slightly offset from their actual location, making them harder to hit. Used by Tallula Donegan.

title: Technique: Fearful Blow
content: A combination of Potence and Presence. A strike that terrifies the victim, causing them to flee or cower.

title: Technique: Master of Illusion
content: A combination of Chimerstry and Auspex. Allows for creating complex, multi-sensory illusions that are difficult to disbelieve.

title: Technique: Quickened Blood
content: A combination of Celerity and Fortitude. The vampire can spend blood to heal or buff themselves with incredible speed in a single turn.

title: Technique: Rend Flesh
content: A combination of Potence and Vicissitude. Allows the user to tear huge chunks of flesh from opponents, causing grievous wounds. Used by Sabbat monsters.

title: Technique: Vanishing Act
content: A combination of Obfuscate and Celerity. The user can disappear from plain sight instantly, even while being observed.

title: Technique: Will to Survive
content: A combination of Fortitude and Willpower. Allows the vampire to ignore wound penalties and stay active even when incapacitated.

title: Tegyrius (Justicar)
content: The Banu Haqim Justicar. A former Vizier who led the schismatics into the Camarilla.

title: Templar (Paladin)
content: An elite Sabbat warrior sworn to protect a Bishop, Archbishop, or Cardinal.

title: Terissa Langley
content: Pack Priest of Yule Tied. 9th Gen Lasombra. Secretly plotting against her sire Lucien with her sister Diana.

title: Test Pool
content: The total number of traits (Attributes + Skills + Bonuses) a player uses to determine dominance in a challenge. Ties go to the defender/higher pool.

title: Thaumaturgy: Hands of Destruction
content: An aggressive path focusing on decay and entropy.

title: Thaumaturgy: Lure of Flames
content: The path of creating and controlling fire. Highly dangerous due to Rötschreck.

title: Thaumaturgy: Movement of the Mind
content: The classic telekinesis path. Lifting objects, flight.

title: Thaumaturgy: Path of Blood
content: The primary path of the Tremere. Manipulation of vitae itself (boiling, theft, potency).

title: Thaumaturgy: Path of Caelestikinesis
content: The path of celestial movement/telekinesis. Used by 'The Knight'.

title: Thaumaturgy: Path of Technomancy
content: A modern path allowing interaction with computers and machines. Used by xX_DarkRat_Xx.

title: The Amphitheater
content: The ritual combat arena located within the NC Arboretum Elysium. Used for duels and executions (like the 2001 Brujah Primogen execution).

title: The Antediluvians
content: The progenitors of the thirteen clans, generally of the 3rd Generation. They are god-like beings of immense power sleeping in the earth. Their waking is the harbinger of Gehenna.

title: The Arena (Arboretum)
content: A specific area within the North Carolina Arboretum designed for Kindred to settle disputes via physical combat. A holdover from Sabbat 'Games of Instinct' that was tolerated by the Camarilla until the location's retirement as Elysium in June 2025.

title: The Baronies
content: The territories within an Anarch Free State, ruled by individual Barons.

title: The Beast
content: The primal, predatory drive within every vampire that urges them to kill, feed, and destroy. It is the source of frenzy and the enemy of Humanity.

title: The Biltmore Estate
content: A forbidden territory within Greater Asheville. By ancient treaty with the Lupines (Werewolves), no Kindred is permitted to enter the grounds. It was formerly the haven of Prince Evander before his destruction. Breaching this boundary acts as a declaration of war against the shifters.

title: The Black Hand (Faction)
content: A secret military sub-sect within the Sabbat. They are the special forces of the Sword of Caine, dedicated to the most dangerous missions and the protection of the sect's oldest secrets.

title: The Book of Nod
content: The sacred text of the Kindred (specifically Noddists and the Sabbat), detailing the history of Caine, the First City, and the prophecy of Gehenna. The Camarilla often suppresses it as dangerous superstition.

title: The Camarilla (The Ivory Tower)
content: The dominant sect of vampires in the Western world. They enforce the Masquerade and the Traditions to hide from humanity and preserve their existence. They are a gerontocracy ruled by the oldest vampires.

title: The Circulatory System
content: A global human trafficking network used by vampires to transport vessels and rare blood types. Hints of its presence in Asheville's underworld.

title: The City of Enoch
content: The First City, built by Caine and his childer. A place where mortals and vampires lived in peace before the Great Deluge destroyed it. Caine ruled here as King.

title: The Cobweb
content: The Malkavian Madness Network. A shared psychic consciousness connecting all Malkavians. Called 'The Madness Network' in the logs.

title: The Consistory
content: The governing council of the Sabbat, comprised of Cardinals and Prisci. They advise the Regent and help steer the Sword of Caine.

title: The Directorate
content: A term sometimes used for the Ventrue board of elders who direct clan policy within a city or region.

title: The Fifth Tradition: Hospitality
content: The courtesy of travel and introduction. Kindred entering a new domain must present themselves to the Prince or their proxy (usually the Sheriff or Seneschal) to acknowledge their authority and request the right to remain. In Asheville, this presentation is often done at Elysium or directly to the Seneschal, Big Ben, prior to his disappearance.

title: The First Tradition: The Masquerade
content: The defining law of the Camarilla and the foundation of modern Kindred survival. It commands that vampires must not reveal their true nature to those not of the Blood. Doing so forfeits one's rights of Domain and usually their life. In the modern nights of the Second Inquisition, this Tradition is enforced with paranoid absolute zero-tolerance.

title: The Fourth Tradition: The Accounting
content: The law of responsibility. Until a Childe is released (acknowledged) by their Sire, the Sire commands them and bears the burden of their sins. If a Childe breaches the Masquerade or insults an Elder, the Sire suffers the punishment. This period of tutelage ensures new Kindred understand the nuances of the Jyhad before being granted independent status.

title: The Golden Rules of LARP
content: The foundational social contract of the game: Be Safe, Be Polite, and 'It's Not Real'. Includes the rules of 'No Touching' and 'No Stunts'.

title: The Great Prank
content: The event in the late 20th century where the Malkavian Elders restored the discipline of Dementation to the clan, replacing Dominate for most members.

title: The Harpy
content: The master of Elysium's social court (distinct from the Keeper). They record boons, announce status, and judge scandals. A Harpy's word can ruin a vampire's social life.

title: The Harpy's Ledger
content: The record of boons and status maintained by the Harpy.

title: The Hex
content: A Nocturne Rock band pioneered by Zephyr. Their music has been suppressed and scrubbed from the internet.

title: The Hushed Puppies
content: A Sabbat pack focused on transportation and criminal organizations. Led by Big Bird.

title: The Independent Alliance
content: A faction (Setites, Giovanni, etc.) that ratified a decision in Las Vegas (Sept 2025) to attack the Sabbat.

title: The Ivory Tower
content: Metaphor for the Camarilla.

title: The Jyhad
content: The eternal, secret war played out between the Antediluvians and Methuselahs, using younger vampires as pawns. It is the great game of manipulation that defines Kindred history.
keywords: eternal struggle,great game,manipulation,puppet show,war of ages

title: The Keeper of Elysium
content: The court officer responsible for the physical safety and maintenance of Elysium. They have the authority to confiscate weapons and expel troublemakers from the safe zone.

title: The Masquerade
content: The First Tradition. The imperative to keep the existence of Kindred secret from mortals. Breaches are punished severely.

title: The Promise of 1528
content: The non-interference treaty between the Camarilla and Clan Giovanni. The Giovanni agreed to stay out of sect politics in exchange for sovereignty over Venice and free trade.

title: The Prometheans
content: A faction within the Anarch Free State (referenced in 'Lore Bits'). They use 'Muses' as spies to keep the Camarilla out.

title: The Rack
content: The prime feeding grounds of a city, usually the club district or red-light district. Access to the Rack is a privilege granted by the Prince or Seneschal.

title: The Red List
content: A list of the most wanted criminals in the Camarilla. Vampires on this list are 'Anathema' and must be destroyed by any Camarilla member on sight.

title: The Red Question
content: An Anarch philosophical movement questioning the need for Elders and the Traditions.

title: The Red Star
content: Also known as Antares. Its appearance in 1999 signaled the beginning of the Nights of Turmoil and was interpreted as the Eye of Gehenna.

title: The Red Star (1999)
content: A celestial event in the World of Darkness that signaled the beginning of the Gehenna Time. Prompted Tallula to crack down on Gehenna cults in Asheville.

title: The Red Star (Event)
content: The appearance of the red star Antares in 1999, signaling the Gehenna Time and prompting Tallula's crackdown.

title: The Sabbat (The Sword of Caine)
content: A sect of vampires who reject the Masquerade and believe they should rule over humanity as gods. They are sworn enemies of the Antediluvians and the Camarilla. They practice the Vaulderie (blood sharing) to break blood bonds and create pack loyalty.

title: The Scourge
content: A court official responsible for thinning the population of the domain. They hunt down Caitiff, unauthorized childer, and Thin-bloods to keep the vampire population sustainable and pure.

title: The Second City
content: Built by the Antediluvians after the Flood in defiance of Caine. It was rife with betrayal and eventually destroyed when the Brujah founder Troile committed diablerie against their sire.

title: The Second Tradition: The Domain
content: The law governing territory and respect within a Prince's city. It dictates that a Kindred's haven is their castle, sovereign and inviolate to others without invitation. In Greater Asheville, this extends to specific Feeding Territories assigned by the Seneschal, where poaching is considered a violation of the Second Tradition.

title: The Seneschal
content: The Prince's right hand and administrator. They handle the boring details of ruling, manage schedules, and stand in for the Prince when they are unavailable.

title: The Shadow Curtain
content: A mystical barrier erected by the Nosferatu Methuselah Baba Yaga over Eastern Europe (Russia), isolating it from the rest of the vampiric world for decades.

title: The Sheriff
content: The martial enforcer of the Prince's laws. They investigate crimes, hunt criminals, and lead the domain's defense in times of war. They often appoint Deputies (Hounds) to assist them.

title: The Sixth Tradition: Destruction
content: The right of life and death, reserved solely for the Elder (the Prince). No Kindred is permitted to destroy another of their kind without the sanction of the Prince, known as the Blood Hunt or Lextalionis. This tradition prevents the domain from descending into chaos and vendetta, concentrating the monopoly of violence in the hands of the ruler.

title: The Southern Lords
content: A historical sect of powerful vampires in the Southeast during the Civil War. They controlled the Dahlonega Mint gold. Tallula Donegan fought against them.

title: The Sword of Caine
content: A moniker for the Sabbat, the sect that formerly held Asheville. They believe in the supremacy of vampires over humanity and the rejection of the Masquerade.

title: The Third Tradition: The Progeny
content: The restriction on creating new vampires. It mandates that a Kindred must have the permission of their Elder (the Prince) to sire. Creating a childe without permission is a capital offense, often resulting in the destruction of both the sire and the unauthorized neonate. In Asheville, Prince Tallula was known to grant this right sparingly, often as a reward for significant service.

title: The Tower
content: A moniker for the Camarilla, the sect currently holding power in Asheville. Dedicated to the Traditions and the preservation of the Masquerade.

title: The Weather
content: A pirate radio show for Kindred hosted by the reclusive Nosferatu Ken Dances. Broadcasts news, songs, and coded messages.

title: The Weather (Radio Show)
content: A pirate radio broadcast hosted by the reclusive Nosferatu Ken Dances. It serves as a news source and coded communication network for the Kindred of Asheville. The show features an eclectic mix of music and cryptic warnings about hunters, Sabbat movements, and masquerade breaches.
keywords: coded messages,communication network,ken dances,nosferatu media,pirate radio

title: The Week of Nightmares (2004)
content: The waking of the Ravnos Antediluvian. It resulted in the destruction of the clan and a psychic backlash. Mentioned in regional history.

title: The Zeitgeist
content: The narrative direction of the chronicle, which focuses on growing past Sabbat traditions. Characters seeking to return to the Sabbat are noted to be at odds with the fundamental themes of the game.

title: Theo Bell (Justicar)
content: The Brujah Justicar. Famous for killing Hardestadt. Represents the 'Loyalist' Brujah.

title: Thin-Blood Alchemy
content: A new discipline developed by 14th/15th Gen vampires. Allows them to brew potions with specific powers. Viewed with suspicion by the Tower.

title: Thin-blood
content: A vampire of the 14th or 15th generation. Their blood is too weak to embrace properly or fuel disciplines efficiently. They are viewed as harbingers of Gehenna and are often hunted by the Scourge.

title: Title: Talon
content: A specific title used by the Harpy (Sister Tiffany/Bugs) to designate their deputies or favored agents of the month.

title: Torpor
content: The death-sleep of vampires. When injured severely or starved, a vampire enters a coma-like state that can last from days to centuries. Ancient vampires sleep in torpor to wait out the ages.

title: Touchstone
content: A human that grounds a vampire's Humanity. Losing a touchstone often leads to immediate degeneration or frenzy.

title: Treaty of Alliance
content: A modern pact between the Giovanni and the Followers of Set (The Ministry), creating the Independent Alliance. It outlines shared territory and mutual defense.

title: Treaty of the Land of the Sky
content: The 1991 agreement that established the Camarilla Praxis in Asheville, overseen by the Tremere.

title: Treaty of the Land of the Sky (1991)
content: The founding document of the Camarilla domain, overseen by Elder Volshebnik. It granted seats to 7 clans and established the Basilica as Elysium.

title: Trinity
content: Gargoyle member of 150 Guns.

title: Tristan de Lovette
content: Toreador Elder and Whip. A master of the social game and a manipulator of emotions. Tristan ensures the Toreador remain at the pinnacle of the city's social hierarchy.

title: Trophy
content: The physical mark (tattoo) carried by an Alastor, identifying them as a hunter of the Red List.

title: True Brujah
content: A bloodline claiming to be the true descendants of the Antediluvian Brujah, viewing the main clan as rebels who killed their sire. They master Time (Temporis).

title: True Sabbat
content: A vampire who has proven themselves to the sect (usually after surviving their Creation Rites and first siege). They are full members with the right to speak in council.

title: Triumphant (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: Special privileges at gatherings (seating, notice). Right to feed in any sect domain (reduces feed actions by 1, min 0).

title: Triumphant (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Ignore the censure of all negative status for one hour. Works even if negative status would normally prevent using status.

title: Twist
content: Ductus of Murder Piñata. 8th Gen Nosferatu. Rumored to be the Sabbat alter-ego of Sheriff Oliver.

title: Twist (Bishop)
content: Nosferatu antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Information in the new Mallori Mayhem Archdiocese.

title: Type-D Aegis
content: A bio-engineered war ghoul or construct used by the Anarch Free State. Made of Toreador and Tzimisce vitae. Immune to blood magic but unstable.

title: Tyrell Jackson
content: Former Ventrue Primogen. Sports lover and 'average guy'. Ashes recovered Jan 2025.

title: Tyrell Jackson (Deceased)
content: Ventrue Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. A sports fan who prided himself on being an 'average guy'.

title: Tzimisce Voivode
content: An honorary title for a powerful Tzimisce elder, respecting their clan's feudal roots.

title: Ultra-Conservative (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who believes the sect needs strict military discipline and centralization to win the Gehenna War. They support the Regent and the hierarchy.

title: Ultra-Conservatives
content: A Sabbat faction that favors strict centralization and military discipline to win the Gehenna War.

title: Ulugh Begh (Justicar)
content: The Tremere Justicar. Known for a hardline stance against the Sabbat. His Archon Ferrum Civis died in Asheville.

title: Unacknowledged
content: A vampire who has not been presented to or accepted by the Prince. They are effectively non-citizens and have no protection under the Traditions.

title: Unacknowledged Feeding
content: The specific prohibition against allowing Unacknowledged Kindred to feed within a Clan's assigned territory. It is the Clan's responsibility to police this, not just the Sheriff's.

title: Unsteady Truce (1914)
content: The agreement between Sabbat and Lupines.

title: Ursula Walker
content: Gangrel Ancilla and the current Seneschal of Greater Asheville. She manages the day-to-day operations of the domain, the allocation of feeding rights, and the granting of Havens. She is a pragmatic stabilizer in a chaotic court.

title: Vaulderie
content: The defining rite of the Sabbat. A communal blood-drinking ritual that breaks existing blood bonds and creates a 'Vinculum' (loyalty tie) to the pack.
keywords: blood bond,blood sharing,bond breaking,lore,loyalty creation,ritual,sabbat,sabbat ritual,vaulderie

title: Victorious (Passive Effect)
content: Passive Effect: On the night gained, others can give you positive status without expending their own traits.

title: Victorious (Spent Effect)
content: Spent Effect: Immediately regain a status you just spent, or remove 'Warned' from self or another in the jurisdiction where won.

title: Vincent's Ear
content: A popular dive bar and music venue, frequent haunt for counter-culture Kindred. Site of Zephyr's last show.

title: Vinculum
content: The bond created by the Vaulderie. It is a web of loyalty varying in strength, binding a pack together emotionally.

title: Vitae
content: The blood of a vampire. It is charged with supernatural energy, fueling disciplines, healing wounds, and waking the dead body each night.

title: Vittoria Pistone
content: Malkavian Ancilla. Has a 'Boss' in her head. Wears a dress and carries a rifle. Known for the tattoo 'Be gay, do crimes, take no shit'.

title: Vizier
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on administration and scholarship (e.g., Magda Doluda).

title: Vulgar (Censure)
content: Censure: All Fleeting Status traits are lost immediately for the night. Cannot gain new Fleeting Status for the night. Lasts one night.

title: Vulgar (Punishment)
content: Punishment: If a second 'Vulgar' is received while holding one, it upgrades automatically to 'Warned'.

title: Wall Street Tunnels
content: A network of tunnels underneath Wall Street in Asheville, emphasized as being more extensive and dangerous in the World of Darkness setting than in the real world.

title: War Party
content: A Sabbat rite where a pack hunts a specific potent enemy (usually an Elder) to diablerize them.

title: War Party Leader
content: A temporary title for a vampire leading a 'War Party' hunt. They have absolute authority during the hunt.

title: War with Lupines (1900)
content: The first major war securing the domain.

title: Warned (Breach)
content: Breach: If censure is broken, gain 'Disgraced' in addition to 'Warned'.

title: Warned (Censure)
content: Censure: Cannot speak to officers in public unless spoken to. Cannot contradict officers. Can apologize (Minor Boon) to avoid breaking censure. May have alternate physical punishments (loss of finger, brand).

title: Warned (Duration)
content: Duration: Lasts 2 games or 1 month. If received again while active, duration extends by 2 games/1 month.

title: Warrior
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on combat (e.g., Daveed Fourié).

title: Wassail
content: The final frenzy where the vampire loses all Humanity and the Beast takes over permanently. The vampire becomes a Wight.
keywords: beast,beast win,final frenzy,game over,loss of soul,mechanics,state,wassail,wight

title: Waynesville
content: Outlying town mentioned as a Sabbat stronghold.

title: Week of Nightmares (1999)
content: The apocalyptic event in Bangladesh where the Ravnos Antediluvian awoke. The resulting psychic backlash drove the Ravnos clan mad, leading to their near-extinction.

title: Whip
content: The assistant to a Primogen. They act as a whip-cracker to keep the clan members in line and ensure the Primogen's orders are followed. They are often younger, ambitious Ancillae.

title: Wight
content: A vampire who has undergone Wassail. They are mindless, language-less monsters who exist only to feed. They are hunted down by all sects.

title: Wild Hunt
content: A Sabbat rite where the sect hunts down a traitor who has revealed Sabbat secrets. The traitor is usually staked and burned.

title: Wild Hunt Leader
content: A temporary title for a vampire leading a 'Wild Hunt' against a traitor. They are deputized to destroy the target by any means necessary.

title: Winter
content: Ductus of 150 Guns. 9th Gen Pander. Serves as the official Emissary to the Camarilla.

title: Winter (Destroyed)
content: Toreador antitribu. Former Sabbat Emissary. Slain May 3, 2025. Ductus of the 150 Guns pack.

title: Witch Hunt
content: A Sabbat pack united by hatred of Tremere. Led by Ductus Dire (Gargoyle).

title: Wraith
content: The ghost of a dead human. They exist in the Shadowlands. Necromancers (Giovanni/Tremere) can bind or bargain with them for information and spying.

title: Yule Tied
content: A Lasombra Sabbat pack based at Montreat College in Black Mountain. Led by Lucien Blake.

title: Zelda Fitzgerald
content: Pack Priest of Old Guard. 10th Gen Toreador antitribu. Childe of Tallula Donegan and Bishop of Spirituality.

title: Zelda Fitzgerald (Asylum Seeker)
content: Toreador Childe of Tallula Donegan. Formerly the Sabbat Bishop of the Arts and Emissary. She sought asylum with the Camarilla on August 2nd, 2025, after Mallori Mayhem's rise.

title: Zeno
content: Lasombra Ancilla. Represented by 'Zolani'. Currently on hold.

title: Zephyr
content: Singer of The Hex. Staged a Masquerade breach and fire at Crossroads Studio in 2025. Presumed dead (or hunter).

title: Zephyr's Breach (March 2025)
content: The massive Masquerade breach at Crossroads Studio caused by the singer Zephyr. Resulted in a fire and significant scrutiny.

title: funnyM0rray
content: Former Nosferatu Primogen. Neonate fandom lover. Missing as of Dec 2024.

title: funnyM0rray (Missing)
content: Nosferatu Neonate and former Primogen. Missing since Dec 7, 2024. A darling of the domain known for her love of fandoms.

title: xX_DarkRat_Xx
content: Nosferatu Neonate and Keeper of Elysium. A tech-savvy Nosferatu who maintains the security and sanctity of the domain's meeting places. They utilize modern surveillance to monitor Elysium for breaches.
